POSITION SUMMARY:

The Transitions Manager is responsible for leading the successful onboarding, integration, opening, and disposition of self-storage properties across the company's owned, managed, acquired, and third-party management portfolios. This role serves as the primary point of coordination following due diligence and is accountable for managing all transition activities necessary to ensure a seamless property launch, management takeover, acquisition integration, new development opening, or disposition.

Acting as the central project leader, the Transitions Manager works closely with cross-functional teams including Operations, Revenue Management, Marketing, Facilities, Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, Devon Executive Leadership, and Inland Acquisitions to coordinate timelines, track deliverables, identify risks, and drive execution.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, systems, and operational requirements. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively with internal and external partners, and takes ownership to ensure a successful transition from beginning to end.

In addition to managing property transitions and dispositions, the Transitions Manager supports operational initiatives, technology implementations, process improvements, and other strategic projects that enhance organizational performance.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Property Onboardings

  • Lead the onboarding and transition process for newly acquired, newly developed, and third-party managed self-storage properties.
  • Serve as the primary project manager and central point of contact throughout the transition lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestone schedules, task lists, and transition timelines.
  • Coordinate activities across Operations, Revenue Management, Marketing, Facilities, Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, and other departments.
  • Facilitate transition meetings, provide status updates, and ensure accountability for assigned deliverables.
  • Monitor risks, identify potential roadblocks, and proactively develop solutions to keep projects on schedule.
  • Ensure all operational, financial, technology, marketing, and staffing requirements are completed prior to opening or takeover.
  • Coordinate ownership communications and provide regular updates throughout the onboarding process.

Job Title: Senior Medical Writer - Vaccine

Job title:Senior Medical Writer - Vaccine

About the Job

The Senior Medical Writer is a member of the Clinical Team. He/she is responsible for the production of key documents related to Clinical Department and Global Medical Affairs activities (e.g., concept documents, protocol, CSR, IBs, Informed Consent Forms, expert reports/integrated summaries, CTD Modules 2 and 5, etc.) in line with the Company as well as external standards, e.g., regulatory requirements or guidelines.

The Medical Writing platform is within Clinical Programs. The Medical Writer reports to the Local Head of Medical Writing for mentoring, appraisal and training. He/she may be the representative of his/her function in one or several clinical teams according to the number of projects he/she has to manage. In this case, he/she is accountable to the Clinical Team Leader for all project issues.

The Medical Writer is a member of one or more clinical teams according to the projects he/she has been assigned. His/her role is to be the referent for his/her function within the team. He/she will be responsible for coordinating the writing of major documents to conduct trials of the projects. He/she has to work in close collaboration with other functions/members of the clinical team to achieve the correct writing of documents.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you'll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi:

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines thattreat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Is in charge of creating, writing, and coordinating concept documents, protocols, informed consent forms, and clinical study reports according to Sanofi Pasteur document standards, tools, and SOPs
  • Is in charge of creating, coordinating, compiling, and editing investigator brochures, updated licensure and renewal documents (clinical overviews, addendum to clinical overviews, CTD updates) according to Sanofi Pasteur standards, tools, and SOPs.
  • Is in charge of creating, writing, and coordinating CTD clinical summaries and overviews in line with Sanofi Pasteur document standards, coordinating the medical writing CTD activities (interaction with RA and other functions involved), and providing the CTD supportive activities within the medical writing department
  • Participates as a member of the clinical team accountable to the Clinical Team Leader for all project issues (role of referent medical writer)
  • Is involved in the peer-review and QC cross-check of documents produced by the Medical Writing platform and in the review of documents produced by other departments (such as SAP and CRF)
  • Contributes to the development of document templates and relevant SOPs. Represents the platform on committees and working groups within Clinical as requested
  • Provides mentoring support to less experienced colleagues and new Company staff members if needed
  • Provides project management of medical writing deliverables for a trial or project, including negotiating timelines, and identifying and escalating issues to both the clinical team and the local Head of Medical Writing
  • Is in charge of supervising subcontracted medical writing activities if needed.
  • May contribute to the updates of templates, SOPs, and other guides for Medical Writing.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Life Sciences or related field of study.
  • 3 or + years of clinical and regulatory medical writing experience within a pharmaceutical company or clinical research organization (CRO).
  • Fluent English communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Professional background documenting an excellent understanding of and experience in clinical development including clinical study performance/methodology/ basic statistics and/or the regulatory environment.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal, time management and technical writing skills.
  • Excellent word-processing skills and experience with electronic document templates are required and other relevant applications (eg, Excel, Outlook, EndNote, Read Cube, Please Review).

WhyChoose Us?

• Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

• Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it's through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

• Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

• Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks' gender-neutral parental leave.

• Work at the forefront of AI-driven research, smart manufacturing, and groundbreaking mRNA platforms that are redefining the future of immunology.

• Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.

• Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. Além de dominar práticas clássicas de FinOps e resiliência cloud, este membro liderará a modelagem de chargeback por tokens, limites de consumo de LLMs e a otimização do custo de inferência em produção.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Governança e FinOps para IA Generativa (Foco Principal)

● Operar e evoluir Gateways de LLM (ex: LiteLLM, Apigee ou proxies proprietários), gerenciando roteamento de modelos, rate limits , orçamentos por time e failover.

● Estruturar e manter modelos de Chargeback e Showback detalhados por consumo de Input/Output Tokens , divididos por aplicação, squad, projeto e caso de uso.

● Definir e monitorar métricas de Unit Economics de IA (calculando custo por requisição, custo por usuário ativo e custo por funcionalidade baseada em LLM).

● Atuar na otimização contínua de custos de inferência, aplicando trade-offs inteligentes entre preço, latência e qualidade do modelo (ex: otimização de prompts , estratégias de caching semântico, escolha entre Pay-As-You-Go vs. Provisioned Throughput).

● Implementar guardrails , alertas dinâmicos no GCP Billing e kill-switches automatizados para evitar picos orçamentários decorrentes de loops ou consumo descontrolado de tokens no Vertex AI.

● Apoiar o estabelecimento de observabilidade de LLMs integrando ferramentas de rastreio ( tracing ) de consumo e custo (ex: Langfuse, Traceloop ou similares).

2. FinOps Tradicional e Atuação Consultiva

● Realizar diagnósticos abrangentes de ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS), identificando desperdícios e oportunidades de otimização financeira e técnica.

● Implementar ações contínuas de rightsizing, gestão de compromissos ( Committed Use Discounts / CUDs ), políticas de ciclo de vida de dados e eliminacão de recursos ociosos.

● Criar e manter dashboards operacionais e executivos no Looker Studio , traduzindo dados complexos de bilhetagem em recomendações acionáveis para engenharia e produto.

● Atuar diretamente com clientes internos e stakeholders técnicos, comunicando impactos financeiros com clareza e autoridade técnica.

3.Sustentação de Arquitetura Cloud, SRE e Kubernetes

● Atuar como referência técnica na avaliação da resiliência, disponibilidade e performance de aplicações em produção.

● Administrar e otimizar custos de clusters Kubernetes (GKE) , ajustando Autoscalers (HPA/VPA), Node Pools e alocação de workloads.

● Garantir a automação de infraestrutura via Terraform (IaC) e manter/evoluir esteiras de CI/CD . ● Apoiar a engenharia na implementação de padrões de observabilidade de infraestrutura (Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, OpenTelemetry).

Requisitos Obrigatórios (Eliminatórios)

● Experiência Profissional: Atuação em Engenharia Cloud, SRE, DevOps ou Arquitetura de Sistemas, sendo pelo menos 2+ anos dedicados a FinOps e Gestão de Custos em Nuvem.

● Domínio de IA Generativa & Vertex AI: Experiência prática na gestão de consumo de LLMs no Vertex AI (GCP) ou ecossistemas equivalentes, com domínio comprovado da estrutura de precificação baseada em Tokens e cotas de inferência.

● Gateways e Governança de LLMs: Vivência técnica na operação de proxies/gateways de IA (LiteLLM ou similares) para controle de acesso, limites por chave de API e orçamento.

● Domínio Técnico da GCP: Conhecimento profundo da plataforma Google Cloud Platform e de suas ferramentas nativas de análise de custos ( GCP Billing, BigQuery Billing Export, Budgets & Alerts).

● Containers & Kubernetes: Experiência na administração e otimização financeira de clusters GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine).

● Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform para provisionamento e automação de ambientes. ● Linguagens de Script: Habilidade prática em Python e/ou Shell Script para automação de rotinas FinOps e coleta de dados via API.

Diferenciais (Desejável):

● Vivência Anterior como Desenvolvedor (Python / Java): Facilita o entendimento da lógica de integração das aplicações com os modelos de IA e pipelines RAG.

● Ferramentas de Observabilidade de LLMs: Experiência prática com Langfuse, LangSmith, Traceloop ou ferramentas similares de tracing de requisições de IA.

● Certificações Oficiais: GCP Professional Cloud Architect , GCP Professional Data/ML Engineer ou FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP).

● Conhecimento em Segurança Cloud: Práticas de DevSecOps, IAM refinado para serviços de IA e governança de dados sensíveis em prompts.

The Business Development Manager (BDM) for NetApp Commercial drives Insight's commercial segment business plan and strategy into the field while serving as a force multiplier for NetApp's field teams. INTERNAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Communicate NetApp contests, SPIFFs, promotions, and new product launches to commercial teams in a timely and compelling manner

• Track and report on key metrics including pipeline growth, deal registration, training participation, and engagement cadence

• Support Insight's marketing team in developing NetApp-focused campaigns and collateral for the commercial segment

EXTERNAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Facilitate quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and leader-to-leader cadences with NetApp leadership to review commercial performance, align on strategy, and address escalations

• Serve as primary point of contact for NetApp's Channel Development Managers and field leadership regarding Insight's commercial NetApp business

• Coordinate with NetApp's Partner Sphere Program team to ensure Insight maintains compliance with partner program requirements and maximizes partner benefits

• Participate in NetApp partner events, training sessions, and certification programs to stay current on product roadmaps, solutions, and competitive positioning

• Provide NetApp with regular intelligence on Insight's commercial market opportunities, customer feedback, and competitive dynamics

• Support NetApp's field teams as a resource extension, including participation in customer meetings, technical discussions, and opportunity development

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

• Deep understanding of NetApp's product portfolio, including storage solutions, Keystone STaaS (Storage-as-a-Service), and cloud-native integrations

• Working knowledge of the NetApp Partner Sphere Program, including tier requirements, incentive structures, deal registration processes, and compliance requirements

• Fluency in NetApp Keystone Storage-as-a-Service (STaaS) model and ability to position consumption-based storage as an alternative to traditional CapEx infrastructure

• Understanding of NetApp's hyperscaler integrations and ability to align NetApp's cloud-native storage capabilities with Insight's cloud migration and hybrid multicloud solution plays

• Familiarity with NetApp Learning Services, certification pathways, and enablement resources

• Strong knowledge of Insight's commercial sales organization, seller base, and organizational structure

• Understanding of Insight's competitive positioning and ability to articulate NetApp's value proposition in the commercial market

• Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce), quoting tools, and sales enablement platforms

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

• Ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority

• Strategic thinking combined with strong execution and attention to detail

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

• Revenue and gross profit growth (year-over-year and vs. plan)

• Pipeline growth (new pipeline created and influenced)

• Net new client acquisition (number of new accounts and associated revenue)

• Client expansion revenue (growth within existing accounts)

• New solution adoption (NetApp Keystone STaaS, AI infrastructure, cloud-native solutions)

• Deal registration uplift and partner program compliance

• Quarterly Business Review (QBR) participation rate and engagement quality

• Training sessions delivered and participation rates

• Partner engagement score and relationship health (NetApp feedback)

• Forecast accuracy and pipeline conversion rates

QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, partner management, or account management in the technology industry

• Proven track record of driving revenue growth and building strategic partnerships in commercial segments

• Experience in a partner-facing or channel management role preferred

• Experience with enterprise storage, infrastructure, or cloud solutions preferred

• Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline development, and forecasting

• Excellent organizational and project management skills

TRAVEL EXPECTATIONS

This position requires 30% travel for customer meetings, partner events, internal business activities, and quarterly business reviews with NetApp leadership. Travel includes visits to key commercial accounts, regional sales offices, and NetApp partner events.

jobs.title: Director, Operations
jobs.excerpt: About Us We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and evolves, we are strengthening the systems, processes, and accountability structures that support our teams, clients, and long-term profitability.

The Director of Operations will translate operational ambiguity into consistent cross-team systems and processes. This person will serve as the primary operational partner to client-delivery teams, especially account management, while gradually expanding their ownership across the broader agency.

This person will partner closely with delivery leaders to identify operational gaps, design practical solutions, document expectations, and move initiatives through implementation and adoption. The role is especially important in areas where strong ideas exist, but ownership is fragmented, processes vary by team, or operational improvements have not yet made it across the finish line.

What You'll Do

You will serve as the primary operational partner for client-delivery teams, helping turn broad expectations into clear, repeatable ways of working.

You will lead more granular operational initiatives that directly affect the client experience and the quality of delivery across teams. This may include improving how monthly and quarterly reporting is planned and executed, standardizing internal strategy meetings, clarifying how client calls and decisions are documented, strengthening cross-team collaboration, or creating more consistent expectations around account management and delivery.

You will work with functional leaders to understand what is needed, identify where responsibilities or workflows are unclear, and build solutions that are practical enough to be adopted. You will not replace delivery leadership or own service strategy; rather, you will provide the structure, project leadership, documentation, and accountability required to operationalize decisions successfully.

You will also manage the Operations Manager, oversee the execution of recurring operational processes, and gradually expand your ownership across broader agency operations.

Client-Delivery Operations

  • Serve as the primary operational partner to Client Strategy and client-delivery leadership, identifying and addressing gaps that affect client-facing work, deliverables, communication, and cross-team coordination.
  • Define clear purpose, ownership, timing, inputs, standards, and expected outcomes for key client-delivery workflows, ensuring processes remain practical, scalable, and aligned across teams.
  • Help delivery leaders move operational initiatives from discussion through documentation, implementation, adoption, and ongoing maintenance, addressing team-level practices that create unnecessary inconsistency or conflict with agency standards.

Cross-Functional Process Design and Implementation

  • Translate delivery-team needs and leadership decisions into clear workflows, responsibilities, timelines, SOPs, and measures of success.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and working sessions that align client strategy, project management, service teams, sales, finance, and operations around clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
  • Identify and resolve root causes, handoff gaps, duplicated effort, and unclear ownership while balancing team-specific needs with agency-wide consistency and scalability.
  • Lead rollout, communication, training, adoption, and ongoing refinement of new or revised processes.

Client Lifecycle and Handoff Governance

  • Own the quality and effective facilitation of the sales-to-services handoff, client onboarding, offboarding, service changes, and other significant client transitions.
  • Establish reporting and accountability structures that surface transition risks, delays, and recurring breakdowns.
  • Ensure lessons from onboarding issues, client escalations, and post-mortems result in concrete operational improvements.

Process Governance and Accountability

  • Establish and govern clear standards, ownership, controls, documentation, reporting, and escalation paths for client-delivery processes.
  • Reinforce accountability and continuous improvement by monitoring adoption, addressing noncompliance, and leading retrospectives that resolve recurring operational issues.

Team Leadership and Operational Execution

  • Build an Operations function known for responsiveness, credibility, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Manage and develop the Operations Manager by setting clear priorities, expectations, deadlines, and quality standards.
  • Delegate day-to-day execution while remaining accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and effectiveness of the team’s work across onboarding, systems administration, data quality, SOPs, operational support, and recurring audits.
  • Maintain a clear distinction between high-value operational ownership and lower-value administrative support.

Systems, Data, and AI Enablement

  • Oversee the governance, accuracy, and effective use of ClickUp, Salesforce, SCOPE, and other core platforms, ensuring appropriate controls are in place to support reliable data and process compliance.
  • Ensure systems support client-delivery workflows, reliable handoffs, consistent documentation, and useful reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve integrations, and reduce unnecessary manual work.
  • Lead the thoughtful adoption of AI and automation across client-delivery and operational workflows, designing well-governed solutions that improve quality, efficiency, consistency, and team capacity.

Profitability and Performance

  • Evaluate client-delivery processes through the combined lens of client experience, efficiency, scalability, risk, and margin.
  • Support reporting and improvement efforts related to client profitability, scope adherence, utilization, churn, account growth, and delivery quality.
  • Identify operational breakdowns that create rework, missed revenue, excess labor, delays, or inconsistent client experiences.
  • Partner with finance, client strategy, project management, and service leadership to improve operational and financial outcomes.
  • Establish measurable success criteria for significant operational initiatives.
  • Ensure process improvements result in practical business value rather than documentation alone.

What You Bring

Operational and Agency Experience

  • Approximately eight or more years of experience in operations, client services, project management, business operations, or a related field.
  • Meaningful experience in a marketing agency, professional-services organization, or similarly complex client-delivery environment.
  • Strong understanding of how account management, project management, service teams, sales, and finance work together.
  • Demonstrated success improving cross-functional client-delivery processes.
  • Experience taking loosely defined initiatives and moving them through implementation and adoption.

Process and Project Leadership

  • Translate broad goals and competing needs into clear, practical plans, workflows, responsibilities, and measures of success, using strong facilitation and project leadership to address root causes and move work forward.
  • Experience developing SOPs, playbooks, standards, and rollout plans.
  • Strong follow-through and a willingness to remain involved until a process is functioning consistently.

Leadership and Accountability

  • At least three years of experience managing and developing people.
  • Set priorities, delegate and inspect work, provide direct feedback, and hold stakeholders accountable while maintaining productive relationships.
  • Strong judgment when ownership is unclear, needs compete, or leaders disagree.
  • Ability to partner with functional leaders without taking over their strategic or people-management responsibilities.

Systems, Data, and AI Fluency

  • Strong working knowledge of CRM, project-management, workflow, and reporting platforms.
  • Practical experience designing AI-enabled workflows or business automations.
  • Use operational data to identify risks and guide action, evaluating potential solutions for business value, complexity, scalability, adoption, and risk.
  • Comfort learning new tools and helping others use them effectively.

Communication and Change Leadership

  • Communicate complex discussions through clear written documentation, decisions, expectations, and actions, while leading effective process rollouts, training, adoption, and change management.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, functional leaders, managers, and individual contributors.
  • A calm, direct, practical communication style.

Why Join Us

You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

jobs.description:
About the Role

Regal is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform & Integrations to own the platform capabilities and partner ecosystem that power our digital products.

Unlike customer-facing Product Managers, this role's primary customers are developers and technical partners, both inside and outside Regal. You will define and improve the APIs, integrations, technical capabilities, and partner experiences that enable Regal's ticketing, ordering, loyalty, payments, and future digital products.

This is a highly technical product role, but not a coding role. You will have GitHub access to engage with technical documentation and develop a deep understanding of the technical landscape, but you will not be expected to write production code. You must, however, be a credible thought partner to senior engineers and able to represent Regal confidently in technical meetings with sophisticated enterprise technology partners.

You will inherit and improve existing third-party integrations, help migrate partners to better solutions, and create structure where little exists today. Success requires technical depth, external-facing judgment, clear communication, and the ability to balance conviction with patience and collaboration. This role is open to Remote US based candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Regal's platform and integration capabilities.
  • Define APIs, observation strategies, integration requirements, developer experiences, and partner-facing documentation standards.
  • Partner closely with Engineering as a technical product thought partner, clarifying tradeoffs, requirements, and implementation paths.
  • Lead external relationships with enterprise technology partners from evaluation through implementation, migration, and ongoing optimization.
  • Improve, replace, or modernize legacy third-party integrations while minimizing operational disruption.
  • Help internal and external developers adopt new platform capabilities and migrate away from weaker legacy solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities clearly to business and technical audiences.


Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful ownership of APIs, integrations, platforms, enterprise systems, or technical products.
  • Strong technical acumen and credibility with engineers, architects, and external technology partners.
  • Experience managing third-party integrations, vendor relationships, and partner adoption or migration efforts.
  • Ability to define technical requirements and recognize what good API documentation and integration design look like.
  • Comfortable operating independently in ambiguous environments and creating clarity where products or processes are immature.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills across technical and business teams.

Preferred

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Prior experience as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, backend engineer, solutions architect, technical lead, or similar technical role.
  • Deep exposure to modern .NET stack and Azure.
  • Experience writing API documentation and managing developer-facing products.
  • Experience with enterprise software vendors, payment providers, e-commerce platforms, loyalty platforms and/or integrations with third party point-of-sale sytems.
  • Experience in a non-technology company building modern product and engineering practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Regal's integration ecosystem becomes easier for partners and internal teams to adopt and maintain.
  • Regal’s API platform migrates to cloud-native technologies.
  • Legacy integrations are improved, replaced, or modernized.
  • Strategic partners can integrate with Regal more quickly and effectively.
  • Engineering teams view Product as a credible technical thought partner.
  • Platform capabilities evolve from one-off implementations into reusable products that accelerate future digital initiatives.

About Regal

Regal Cinemas - where movie magic meets unforgettable experiences!

At Regal Cinemas, part of Regal Cineworld, each day is a celebration of everything film and entertainment. From the first popcorn crunch to the closing credits, we create moments that spark joy, laughter, and a little bit of movie magic.

With over 9,000 screens across 751 locations in 10 countries, including Cineworld, Picturehouse, Cinema City, Yes Planet, and Regal Cinemas in the U.S., we bring the joy of movies to millions.

Our Benefits

  • Free movie passes and discounted concessions
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Summer half-day Fridays
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. The Executive Director, AI Forward Deployed Engineering Lead will lead the engineering delivery of agentic AI solutions embedded within business functions, with responsibility across solution architecture, development, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be critical to transforming existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by partnering closely with business teams to design and deploy practical, scalable solutions that address high value use cases. The ideal candidate will bring strong engineering leadership, solution orientation, and cross functional execution skills to guide the development of fit for purpose AI applications, oversee deployment into real world operating environments, and ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Working closely with product leaders, platform teams, data partners, business stakeholders, and transformation leaders, this role will help accelerate AI adoption, drive measurable business impact, and ensure solutions continuously evolve based on operational feedback and emerging needs.

Major Accountabilities

  • Define and lead the engineering strategy, delivery model, and execution approach for forward deployed agentic AI solutions across business functions.
  • Oversee the design, development, implementation, and ongoing support of AI solutions that transform business processes and products into agentic workflows.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and domain experts to identify requirements, shape technical solutions, and ensure adoption in operational environments.
  • Lead engineering teams in building, deploying, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and user centered AI applications aligned with enterprise architecture and standards.
  • Drive integration of AI solutions with existing systems, data sources, workflows, and operational processes to enable effective end to end execution.
  • Establish engineering practices, support models, and feedback loops that promote quality, reliability, operational performance, and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate closely with platform, data, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions leverage shared capabilities and comply with enterprise requirements.
  • Communicate engineering priorities, solution progress, business impact, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
  • 15 plus years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership over senior product leaders, with a strong track record of defining and scaling enterprise level product strategy and execution.
  • Deep expertise in AI driven product management, including experience bringing innovative data, machine learning, and generative AI products from concept to commercialization in complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, with experience leading directors and senior product teams, building high performing organizations, and establishing effective product operating models and governance.
  • Strong cross functional and executive influence skills, with demonstrated success partnering across Engineering, Innovation, Commercial, Data Science, and business leadership to align strategy, prioritize investments, and drive outcomes.

jobs.description:
AskBio Inc., a wholly owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a fully integrated gene therapy company dedicated to developing life-saving medicines and changing lives. The company maintains a portfolio of clinical programs across a range of neuromuscular, central nervous system, cardiovascular, and metabolic disease indications with a clinical-stage pipeline that includes investigational therapeutics for congestive heart failure, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, multiple system atrophy, Parkinson’s disease, and Pompe disease. AskBio’s gene therapy platform includes Pro10™, an industry-leading proprietary cell line manufacturing process, and an extensive array of capsids and promoters. With global headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, and European headquarters in Edinburgh, Scotland, the company has generated hundreds of proprietary capsids and promoters, several of which have entered pre-clinical and clinical testing.

Our vision: Pioneering science to create transformative molecular medicines.

Our mission: Lead innovative science and drive clinical outcomes to transform people's lives.

Our principles:

  • Advance innovative science by pushing boundaries.

  • Bring transformative therapeutics to patients in need.

  • Provide an environment for employees to reach their fullest potential.

Our values:

  • Be a Pioneer. We are not afraid of the impossible and to innovate to make gene therapies accessible to those in need.

  • Cultivate Collaboration. Strive to be the best teammate, actively listen, openly communicate, and embrace diverse points of view.

  • Embrace Responsibility. We are humbled by the enormity of our mission. We hold a relentless commitment to advance science and clinical outcomes for our patients, families, and caregivers.

  • Raise the Bar. Continuously drive improvements and efficiencies. Seek and provide constructive feedback. Have a bias for learning and action.

  • Act with Uncompromising Integrity. Be honest, transparent, and committed to doing what’s right in every situation. Make clear commitments and follow through.

Position Summary

The Director, Regulatory Affairs will serve as a U.S.-based regulatory strategy lead for assigned development programs, with responsibility for driving global regulatory strategy and providing focused leadership for regulatory activities. This role will provide regulatory direction for preclinical and clinical development of AskBio’s product candidates, working closely with cross-functional Regulatory team members, Global Project Teams, subject matter experts, and external partners to ensure regulatory strategies are aligned with applicable health authority requirements and expectations.

This position will support and/or lead interactions with global health authorities, including EMA and other European and ROW agencies, and will contribute to high-quality, timely regulatory submissions, agency meeting packages, regulatory designations, and development-stage submissions.

The role will report into Regulatory Affairs and work remotely from within the United States.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as Regulatory Affairs lead or representative for assigned programs, providing strategic regulatory guidance and interpretation to support product development in alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and health authority expectations

  • Develop and execute innovative, integrated regulatory strategies and timelines for assigned programs, including strategies that support global development and European regulatory objectives

  • Lead or support preparation and submission of regulatory documents for clinical development programs, including CTAs, amendments, scientific advice briefing packages, regulatory designations, and future marketing application activities, as applicable

  • Lead regulatory document review, comment resolution, and approval processes to ensure documents are high quality, scientifically sound, submission-ready, and aligned with regulatory strategy

  • Prepare and/or contribute to health authority meeting requests, briefing documents, responses to questions, and other communications with regulatory authorities.

  • Lead or participate in internal governance meetings, cross-functional project team discussions, and regulatory agency interactions, effectively communicating regulatory strategy, risks, options, and recommendations

  • Collaborate closely with Clinical, Nonclinical, CMC, Quality, Medical, Project Management, and other functions to ensure regulatory strategies are appropriately integrated into development plans and executed in a timely manner

  • Provide regulatory guidance on European requirements, expectations, procedures, and opportunities, including agency engagement and expedited development mechanisms where appropriate

  • Manage or provide oversight of external regulatory partners, consultants, CROs, and vendors supporting assigned regulatory activities

  • Support regulatory due diligence for busness development or licensing opportunities, as needed.

  • Ensure regulatory activities are conducted in compliance with applicable regulations, guidelines, internal procedures, and quality standards by staying up to date on contemporary guidance, regulations and applicable directives and laws

  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, accountability, sound judgment, and a patient-focused mindset in a fast-paced matrix environment

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, medical, pharmacy, or related discipline

  • 10+ years of regulatory affairs or related drug development experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related industry

  • Experience supporting and/or leading regulatory submissions, health authority interactions, or regulatory strategy for clinical-stage development programs

  • Experience with authoring and submitting PINDs, CTAs and INDs for biologics, gene therapy, cell therapy, or other advanced therapeutic technologies

  • Demonstrated ability to write, review, and provide strategic input on regulatory documents, including briefing packages, designation requests, clinical trial applications, amendments, responses to health authority questions, and marketing application components

  • Strong understanding of FDA, EMA, MHRA, and other health authority regulations, guidelines, procedures, and expectations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build clear regulatory rationales and communicate complex issues effectively to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders

  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed, fast-paced environment

  • Sound judgment, problem-solving capability, attention to detail, and a high degree of accountability

  • Proficiency with VEEVA RIM or similar systems, Microsoft Office products and applications commonly used in Regulatory Affairs

  • Mission-driven, patient-focused mindset with enthusiasm for contributing to development of gene therapy products for patients with serious diseases

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills

  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, PharmD, MD or equivalent) in a scientific, medical, pharmacy, or related discipline

  • Experience with European regulatory strategy, including CTAs, scientific advice, PRIME, ILAP, MAA planning, or interactions with EMA, MHRA, national competent authorities, or other European regulatory bodies

  • Experience developing and executing integrated global regulatory strategies for clinical-stage and registration-directed programs

  • Experience with AAV-based gene therapy, rare disease, biologics, or advanced therapeutic medicinal products

Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Recruiting agencies: Proper Voltage does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions. Please do not contact any employees directly unless you have an existing engagement with the company.

About Proper Voltage

Proper Voltage is unlocking the next generation of battery technology across robotics, data centers, and defense.

We're building intelligent battery systems that make advanced chemistries (sodium-ion, lithium-titanate, lithium-silicon) work in products that were never designed for them. Humanoid robots can upgrade power systems without redesigning their entire platform. Data centers get safer, cheaper backup power. Drones and autonomous vehicles get higher energy density without lengthy integration cycles.

If you want to work on hard engineering problems that matter this is the place.

Job Overview

The Director of Logistics owns Proper Voltage's end-to-end freight and logistics function: inbound material flow, outbound customer delivery, packaging design and validation, and reverse logistics. Our finished product is a large-format battery system, classified as a dangerous good, shipped to commercial and defense customers who expect flawless delivery from day one.

This role reports to the VP of Supply Chain and works closely with the Director of Supply Chain (contract manufacturer and procurement relationships), the Materials Program Manager (who will report to this role), engineering, and our customers' receiving and logistics teams.

This is a build-from-scratch role. Outbound shipping for a large dangerous-goods product has real safety, regulatory, and customer-relationship stakes that a generalist logistics function cannot absorb as a side responsibility. You will set up the carrier relationships, the packaging program, and the customer delivery process before our first commercial shipments, and you will own the freight strategy across both inbound and outbound as we scale.

Scope

  • Inbound: you own freight forwarder relationships and inbound freight strategy across our supplier base, including Asia-origin suppliers. When a supplier quotes ex-works or FOB origin, you decide how that material moves from the supplier's dock to our contract manufacturers, and you negotiate the rates and service levels that get it there reliably and cost-effectively.
  • Outbound: you own dangerous-goods-compliant shipping to commercial and defense customers. This includes carrier qualification, hazmat documentation and labeling, driver certification requirements, and the customer-facing delivery experience. Our product ships in both individual units (in the low hundreds of pounds) and larger rack configurations (over a thousand pounds), so packaging and handling requirements span a wide range.
  • Packaging: our contract manufacturers support packaging execution, and we expect to bring in specialized packaging engineering support as needed. You will own the coordination and final validation (drop testing sign-off, handling instructions, ensuring the packaging solution meets DG and customer requirements) without needing to be the hands-on packaging designer.
  • Reverse logistics: you build the process for defective unit returns, including dangerous-goods-compliant return shipping, customer coordination, and field service logistics support.
  • This role starts as an individual contributor with the Materials Program Manager reporting to you. The team will grow as volume and complexity increase.

Who this role is for

  • You have real experience shipping a regulated, hazardous, or safety-critical product at commercial scale. You know how dangerous goods classification, carrier certification, and hazmat documentation actually work in practice, not just in theory.
  • You have built or significantly scaled a logistics function from an early stage. You've negotiated freight forwarder contracts, qualified carriers, and set up a customer delivery process where none existed before.
  • You think about total landed cost, not just freight rate. You know when using your own forwarder instead of a supplier's preferred logistics provider saves real money and improves visibility, and you know how to make that case and execute on it.
  • You are comfortable owning both inbound and outbound freight as one connected function, and you understand where that overlaps with (and stays distinct from) supplier commercial negotiation.
  • You are comfortable in early-stage environments where the playbook is still being written. You will build the carrier relationships, packaging program, and delivery process from the ground up.

This role is not a fit if

  • Your logistics experience is limited to standard, non-hazardous freight.
  • You need an established freight and carrier network in place before you can be effective. You will build this.
  • You are looking for a role focused only on strategy without hands-on operational ownership. This role is deeply hands-on in the near term.
  • You would find a startup operating tempo frustrating.

What you'll do

Inbound logistics

  • Establish and manage freight forwarder relationships across our supplier base, with particular focus on Asia-origin freight.
  • Negotiate freight rates and service levels. Identify opportunities to shift from supplier-managed freight to our own forwarder relationships when it reduces cost or improves visibility.
  • Own cargo visibility and tracking for critical inbound shipments, in partnership with the Materials Program Manager.
  • Coordinate customs clearance and import compliance with brokers and internal partners.

Outbound logistics

  • Qualify and manage dangerous-goods-certified carriers for outbound shipments to commercial and defense customers.
  • Own hazmat shipping documentation, labeling, and driver certification requirements. Ensure every outbound shipment is fully compliant.
  • Build and own the customer delivery experience, including scheduling, communication, and issue resolution.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues arising in transit (damage, handling, documentation errors).

Packaging

  • Partner with our contract manufacturers and, as needed, outside packaging engineering resources on packaging design for individual unit and multi-unit rack shipments. Own final validation: drop testing sign-off and handling instructions.
  • Coordinate packaging vendor relationships for custom crating, palletization, and protective packaging as needed. Deep hands-on packaging design experience is a plus, not a requirement; support resources are available.

Reverse logistics

  • Build the RMA and defective unit return process, including dangerous-goods-compliant return shipping.
  • Coordinate field service and pickup logistics with customers.

Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Manage the Materials Program Manager and align inbound freight strategy with material readiness needs.
  • Execute freight strategy within terms set by Director of Supply Chain as part of supplier commercial strategy
  • Partner with engineering, finance, and customer-facing teams on delivery commitments and cost.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in logistics, transportation, or supply chain operations, including direct ownership of dangerous goods or other regulated product shipping.
  • Direct experience with hazmat/DG shipping compliance: carrier certification, documentation, labeling, and driver requirements.
  • Experience negotiating freight forwarder contracts and managing an international freight network, including Asia-origin lanes.
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a logistics function, including customer delivery processes, from an early stage.
  • Direct people management experience.
  • Ability to operate independently and build process where none exists yet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience shipping industrial batteries or other energy storage products.
  • Experience with packaging design and validation for heavy or large-format products.
  • Experience serving defense or government customers with specific delivery and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with reverse logistics and field service coordination.
  • Early-stage startup experience building logistics functions from zero.
  • Familiarity with customs brokerage and cross-border trade compliance.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary of $200,000 to $220,000, plus equity.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Flexible PTO with a generous holiday policy.
  • Carlsbad, CA or near our contract manufacturers preferred. Open to fully virtual for the right candidate. Regular travel to our contract manufacturers, vendors, and occasional customer site visits.

jobs.description:
N3XT is a Wyoming-chartered Special Purpose Depository Institution (SPDI). We are a 100% reserved, non-lending bank designed to serve as a secure bridge between traditional capital markets and public blockchain infrastructure. Backed by Paradigm, HACK VC, Winklevoss Capital, and Pharsalus, we prioritize safety and transparency for institutional B2B clients.

Company: N3XT

Location: NYC Preferred (Flexible / Remote)

Job Type: Full-Time

How the Banking World is Changing

The global banking architecture is undergoing a foundational paradigm shift. Traditional fractional-reserve banking systems and legacy settlement networks are increasingly constrained by T+1/T+2 settlement delays, operational counterparty risk, restricted operating hours, and fragmented capital efficiency. As institutional finance converges with public blockchain infrastructure, capital markets demand programmatic, 24/7/365 settlement rails backed by total transparency and unencumbered reserves. Operating under a Wyoming Special Purpose Depository Institution Charter, N3XT represents the next evolution of narrow banking—providing a fully-reserved, institutional-grade bridge between traditional capital markets and digital asset liquidity.

About N3XT

N3XT is a Wyoming-chartered Special Purpose Depository Institution (SPDI). We are a new, innovative bank designed to serve as the premier settlement and banking infrastructure bridging traditional capital markets and public blockchain rails. Backed by elite institutional investors including Paradigm, HACK VC, Winklevoss Capital, and Pharsalus, we provide institutional-grade security, execution velocity, and total transparency for global B2B clients, trading desks, and market makers operating in a globally connected world.

About the Role

Growth at N3XT is driven by market structure design, deep network effects, and high-value institutional execution. The Commercial team is responsible for introducing narrow banking and frictionless fiat-to-digital settlement to the world’s most sophisticated capital markets participants.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Business Development Manager with a proven track record in institutional capital markets, trading infrastructure, or institutional sales to architect and drive our expansion across premier global financial hubs.

Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial & Growth, you will lead high-stakes deal origination and strategic coverage. You will operate at the intersection of US banking rails, institutional liquidity flows, and digital asset markets—engaging CFOs, Treasurers, Chief Investment Officers, and Heads of Trading to position N3XT as the primary banking and settlement partner for institutional capital.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Institutional Origination & Deal Structuring: Lead end-to-end deal cycles with tier-1 and mid-tier institutional market participants, including market makers, quantitative funds, OTC desks, prime brokers, and high-volume institutional liquidity providers.
  • C-Suite Advisory & Treasury Solutions: Partner with client CFOs, Treasurers, and Heads of Trading to architect bespoke banking setups that optimize pre-funding requirements, accelerate fiat-crypto settlement cycles, and maximize collateral liquidity management.
  • Capital Markets Flywheel & Ecosystem Expansion: Scale N3XT’s institutional referral ecosystem ("Meet me @ N3XT"), embedding our banking infrastructure into prime brokerage, custody, and trading counterparty networks to drive exponential network effects.
  • Strategic Event & Industry Representation: Represent N3XT as a subject matter expert at premier global conferences (Capital Markets, FX, and Digital Asset summits)—driving C-level bilateral meetings, keynotes, and rapid client onboarding.
  • Commercial Strategy & Pipeline Governance: Own revenue, deposit, and transaction volume KPIs. Utilize pipeline analytics and market feedback to inform executive leadership on product roadmap priorities and strategic market positioning.

What You’ll Need

  • 5–8+ years of commercial experience in Capital Markets BD/Sales, Prime Brokerage, FX/OTC Trading, or Institutional Digital Asset Sales.
  • Institutional Capital Markets Expertise: Deep understanding of market structure, clearance and settlement mechanics, trade workflows, liquidity management, and prime brokerage dynamics.
  • Digital Asset & Crypto Fluency: Sophisticated understanding of institutional digital asset infrastructure—specifically stablecoin rails, fiat-crypto ramp mechanics, CeFi liquidity desks, and emerging tokenized asset workflows.
  • Proven Track Record of Deal Origination: Demonstrated history of independently prospecting, structuring, and closing complex, high-value institutional financial services accounts.
  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Ability to map complex market ecosystems, navigate multi-stakeholder approval processes, and utilize data-driven insights to refine target account-based strategies.

Nice to Have

  • An established network of C-level decision-makers across Wall Street, Tier-1 trading desks, market makers, exchanges, and institutional fintechs.
  • Direct experience navigating institutional onboarding, complex KYB/AML requirements, and multi-jurisdictional banking regulations.
  • Experience executing "land and expand" programs or account-based marketing (ABM) targeting high-net-volume accounts.

Core Values: Who We Are

  • Get It Done: We deliver on our commitments, meet deadlines, and take complete accountability to achieve our goals.
  • Never Settle: We pursue excellence through continuous improvement, constantly elevating client experience, security, and personal growth.
  • Integrity Over Ease: We operate with radical transparency, honesty, and respect—doing what is right for our clients, team, and stakeholders, even when it is hard.

jobs.description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an OT Security Consultant to own how Packetlabs evaluates risk in sensitive, high-stakes systems where uptime, safety, and reliability cannot be compromised. The OT Security Consultant is a specialized technical role focused on assessing Operational Technology (OT) environments across all industries. This role is about applying deep security judgment to environments where conventional testing approaches are too blunt, and where credibility comes from knowing when to push and when to hold back.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and operational restraint. OT environments (industrial control systems, SCADA, and field devices) demand a consultant who can identify real risk without introducing it. You will work directly with clients to understand their environments and deliver findings that improve security posture without disrupting operations. At Packetlabs, you’ll be backed by a team that is deeply committed to technical excellence. We hold ourselves to a high standard, invest heavily in our team, and give our experts the autonomy and support needed to become leaders in their field.

What you’ll be doing

  • Security Architecture Reviews
    • Perform holistic tabletop reviews covering both technical and non-technical risk across OT environments, without engaging in high-risk manual or automated activity
    • Analyze for areas of negative impact, high risk, and single points of failure (SPOF) within sensitive, legacy networks
    • Apply structured judgment to identify where risk is concentrated and where controls are missing
    • Adapt review depth and approach to the operational realities of each client environment
  • OT Risk Identification & Assessment
    • Identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses across Operational Technology environments, including Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, and field devices
    • Assess legacy and sensitive networks where conventional testing methods carry unacceptable operational risk
    • Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable
    • Prove impact where appropriate, exercising restraint where the environment demands it
  • Client Advisory & Program Improvement
    • Support OT clients with security program improvements, identifying which critical controls are needed
    • Refine testing scope collaboratively as engagements proceed and the environment becomes clearer
    • Translate technical findings into guidance that clients can act on across both technical and leadership audiences
    • Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication, and operational awareness
  • Methodology & Continuous Improvement
    • Contribute to the maturity of Packetlabs' OT testing methodology and practice
    • Stay current on OT threats, attack techniques, and defensive controls
    • Share knowledge with the broader team to minimize blind spots and strengthen collective capability
    • Help raise the standard of OT security work across the firm

Who you are

  • No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.
  • Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.
  • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard and it shows in what you produce.
  • Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.
  • Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
  • Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.
  • Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.
  • You must be located in Texas or Florida.

What you bring

  • A graduate of an Information Security or Computer Science degree program
  • Professional qualifications (one or more preferred): GICSP, GRID, GCIP, CSSA, CACE, CISSP, OSCP
  • 3+ years experience assessing or operating within OT, ICS, or SCADA environments
  • Strong understanding of the operational constraints that make OT testing distinct from IT testing
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • A demonstrated commitment to continuous learning in a rapidly evolving field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in unfamiliar or highly specialized environments

What success looks like

  • Clients gain a clear, accurate understanding of their OT risk without any operational disruption
  • Findings are credible, impactful, and directly actionable for both technical and leadership audiences
  • Engagements are delivered to a consistently high standard with strong client confidence
  • Scope is managed well as engagements evolve, with risk surfaced early and clearly
  • Packetlabs' OT methodology and practice continue to mature through your contribution
  • Clients trust Packetlabs as a partner that understands the stakes of testing sensitive environments

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes OT engagements where your judgment genuinely matters
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs expanding OT practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity

jobs.title: Research Assistant (Part-time)
jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEW Civic Nation seeks a Research Assistant who will support Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Civic Nation seeks a Research Assistant who will support Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives. The Research Assistant, reporting to the Director of Digital Strategy, will play a critical role in providing accurate election information to voters, fact-checking, and more. This position will also provide media and social monitoring of news development and research support.

This is a part-time temporary role for 20 hours per week, concluding December 15, 2026.

ABOUT THE COMMUNICATIONS TEAM

The Communications Team is focused on telling the story of Civic Nation’s work. Through creative messaging, digital activations, media relations, and more, the Communications Team amplifies the work of all Civic Nation initiatives and campaigns.

ABOUT CIVIC NATION

Civic Nation is an impact hub for the ideas, leaders, and initiatives that strengthen civic culture, civic power, and civic participation. We shift culture, systems, and policy by bringing together individuals, grassroots organizers, industry leaders, and influencers to tackle our nation’s most pressing social challenges. Five initiatives are a part of the Civic Nation family: ALL IN Campus Democracy Challenge, Change Collective, It’s On Us, We The Action, and When We All Vote.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Update the 50-state election deadline and law tracker daily, and monitor and record state and local election dates and law updates.
  • Develop issue one-pagers, memos, reports, explainers, and other documents detailing critical issues for Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives.
  • Monitor news and social media posts to aid the Communications team in responding to actionable items within relevant newscycles.
  • Track legislative, legal, and administrative developments regarding Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives.
  • Fact-check documents and other materials for accuracy in collaboration with the Research Contractor.
  • Maintain organized documentation and research files.
  • Other reasonable and relevant duties as assigned.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 1+ years of research experience, including academic experience and internships.
  • 1+ years of experience in nonprofit and/or political environments, including internships.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, including Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and Google Docs, and Asana.
  • Academic research experience, preferred.

YOUR COMPETENCIES

  • A strong commitment to democratic engagement and involvement with civic engagement activities.
  • Demonstrated experience balancing multiple projects on tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience translating large amounts of information into accessible explainers and memos.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • A self-starter, entrepreneurial, adaptable, and driven to take the initiative and complete tasks on deadline.
  • Ability to manage large amounts of information and spreadsheets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, critical thinking, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
  • A strong ability to listen, understand, connect, earn the trust of, and collaborate with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Comfort in a rapidly changing environment and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities at any given time.
  • Personal and professional commitment to promoting and investing in cross-cultural skills and awareness related to individuals from broad backgrounds, races, ethnicities, religions, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability.

SALARY

The Washington, DC-based salary range for this position is $18.40/hour. This role will work 20 hours per week and conclude on December 15, 2026.

PROCESS TIMELINE

Candidates can expect the following hiring process and timeline (please note that this timeline may be subject to change):

  • August 25-August 27: First-Round Interviews
  • August 31: Writing Assignment
  • September 2-September 4: Final Interviews
  • September 9: Hiring Decision announced

All candidates will be notified via email of the status of their application on or before the completion of the search.

TO APPLY

To apply, submit a cover letter and resume below. The cover letter, addressed to Valeria Villarroel, should be concise, compelling, and include why you would like to work for Civic Nation. Applications will be accepted until August 16, 2026.

Driven by our values, Civic Nation aims to recruit candidates representative of the communities and populations we serve. Towards that goal, we know that a diverse workforce allows us to see issues facing our democracy in more nuanced ways, creating the thought leadership needed to fulfill our mission and reach our goals. Civic Nation is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes people from all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply.

ABOUT US

At DataEQ, we transform unstructured customer and public feedback into powerful, actionable insights. By combining cutting-edge AI with our unique human data labeling platform, we help some of South Africa’s leading companies—including top banks, retailers, and insurers—enhance customer experiences, manage risk, and optimize digital services.

Our innovative solutions are driving real impact across industries that matter.

When you join DataEQ, you become part of a dynamic and diverse team of over talented professionals, including data scientists, analysts, product specialists and creative problem-solvers. We’re committed to fostering a collaborative, supportive environment where fresh ideas and innovation thrive.

With a strong focus on innovation and a deep commitment to client success, we empower our teams to deliver meaningful work that matters.

If you’re passionate about building long-term client relationships, driving value, and supporting strategic account growth conversations, DataEQ is the place for you.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for an Account Director to manage a portfolio of key client accounts across industries such as financial services, telecoms, and retail. Reporting to the MD of the DataEQ Core division, you’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery, client satisfaction, and ongoing growth.

You will be the primary point of contact for your accounts, responsible for retention, renewals, and upselling opportunities, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to tailor solutions that meet client needs.

This is a remote-first position, offering autonomy, collaboration, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, commercial acumen, and exceptional relationship-building skills. While specific requirements may vary, we generally look for the following qualities and experience:

Experience & Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

At DataEQ, we believe in supporting our team—professionally and personally. We value outcomes over inputs and offer a flexible, remote-first work culture where you can thrive.

While we’re globally distributed, most of our team is based in Johannesburg and Cape Town. If you're local, you’ll enjoy opportunities to co-work on Together Tuesdays, attend regular social events, and connect face-to-face.

If you’re a strategic relationship-driven professional excited about helping clients succeed and growing your career, we’d love to hear from you.
