About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Customer Service Representative (Telehealth)

About the Role

This isn't a traditional call center role.

At LumiMeds, our Customer Service Representatives are the first point of contact for patients who trust us with their health journey. You're not simply answering questions—you'll help patients navigate our platform, resolve issues with empathy and urgency, and ensure every interaction leaves them feeling supported.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, takes ownership of problems, and enjoys helping people. If you need step-by-step instructions for every situation, this probably isn't the right role. If you enjoy solving problems, thinking critically, and creating an exceptional patient experience, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Own

  • Provide exceptional support to patients via phone, email, chat, and SMS
  • Resolve patient inquiries related to appointments, prescriptions, billing, subscriptions, and account management
  • Guide patients through the telehealth experience with empathy, professionalism, and accuracy
  • Escalate clinical questions appropriately while maintaining patient confidence
  • Coordinate with Clinical, Operations, Sales, and Patient Success teams to resolve complex issues
  • Document every interaction accurately within our CRM and patient management systems
  • Follow up proactively to ensure issues are fully resolved
  • Identify recurring patient pain points and provide recommendations to improve processes

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Service, Patient Support, or Customer Experience

  • Professional-level English communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Strong empathy without losing efficiency or accountability
  • Experience using CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar

  • You resolve issues efficiently while maintaining empathy
  • You take ownership instead of passing problems to others
  • You communicate clearly across teams and with patients
  • You proactively identify opportunities to improve the patient experience
  • You thrive in an environment where priorities evolve quickly

Why LumiMeds?

We're building a company where patient experience is just as important as clinical outcomes. Every conversation matters, every interaction builds trust, and every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on someone's health journey.

If you're excited about helping people, solving problems, and being part of a fast-growing telehealth company, we'd love to hear from you.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

About the Role

Cencora is seeking an experienced service designer with healthcare operations experience to help drive operational innovation across the practices within its Management Services Organizations (MSOs). This is a newly created, high-visibility role, and you will partner directly with MSO leadership, practice physicians, and Cencora’s MSO Platform team to design solutions to complex operational challenges. Your work will help advance community-based healthcare across the country, making care more accessible and accelerating the delivery of new clinical therapies to patients.

The range of initiatives you will support is diverse and could include topics such as introducing new clinical therapies, customer and patient experience, revenue cycle management, patient retention, and staffing models. Work will span across different clinical specialties, currently including oncology and retina. All work will be deeply collaborative, ensuring solutions are grounded in clinician and patient needs, economically viable, and scalable across practices. This is an operational and design role, not a clinical or clinical-research position — you will help shape how care is delivered and experienced operationally, in collaboration with clinical leadership.

This is a lead level position that is part of a new and growing team. You will be expected to independently scope, plan, and execute engagements without close day-to-day supervision. Comfort and experience leading human-centered design engagements and interacting with senior leadership are critical for success.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Cencora and MSO leadership — including senior executives — to prioritize and scope operational innovation initiatives.

  • Independently plan and execute complex, sometimes ambiguous engagements end to end, from discovery through delivery, with minimal oversight.

  • Map complex operational systems across clinical practices and MSOs to surface dependencies, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including current-state journey mapping of patient, physician, and staff experiences to identify pain points and surface opportunities.

  • Synthesize complex information into clear findings and recommendations.

  • Ideate and explore possible solutions, including market scans of existing solutions as well as first principles ideation.

  • Visualize, test, and refine concepts through diverse means of prototyping, gathering stakeholder feedback, evaluating off-the-shelf solutions, and using solution evaluation frameworks.

  • Partner with platform, operations, technology, and clinical practice stakeholders, including designing and facilitating cross-functional workshops and working sessions.

  • Build and deliver clear, persuasive presentations and other deliverables that communicate findings, solutions, and plans.

  • Develop playbooks and toolkits that support scaled communication, adoption, and implementation of solutions across MSOs and practices.

  • Maintain a shared repository of research findings, journey maps, and service blueprints to preserve institutional knowledge as the function grows.

  • Help define the practices, tools, and standards for the brand-new practice support and operational innovation capability at Cencora.

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years of experience in service design, experience design, CX strategy, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently scope and lead complex, ambiguous design engagements without close supervision.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in human-centered design methodology, design strategy, systems/ecosystem mapping, journey mapping, and related service design methods.

  • Experience in healthcare operations — preferably physician practice management, medical groups, health systems, MSOs, or pharmacy — sufficient to engage credibly with clinical and practice leadership from day one.

  • Strong workshop facilitation skills, including experience facilitating senior executives and other high-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent research and synthesis skills, able to turn complex information into clear insight.

  • Fluency in technology’s role in operations, and experience with tech vendor/solution selection.

  • Business acumen to understand basic business financials and evaluate the economic viability of solutions, in partnership with the finance team.

  • Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, with the presence and polish to influence senior executive audiences.

  • Comfort and flexibility working across varied problem domains (operations, patient/customer experience, retention, therapy launch, etc.).

  • Willingness to travel regularly to MSO and practice sites.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Additional Qualifications

  • Strong visual design skills, with the ability to produce concept visuals and also polished, presentation-ready visual deliverables.

  • Prior experience mentoring, leading, or managing designers or researchers.

  • Familiarity with revenue cycle management, patient access, or therapy commercialization.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. This role has a hard language requirement. You must be fully fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken. A significant portion of the frontline workforce is Spanish-speaking and having a recruiter who can communicate directly in Spanish is essential to sourcing and retaining the right candidates.

This is a high-volume, process-driven recruiting role. You will post jobs continuously across every active market, filter and maintain a candidate database, verify credentials including specialty licenses, and keep the pipeline full so the company can staff new work quickly when it comes in. If you are bilingual, organized, experienced in frontline or blue-collar recruiting, and take ownership of the full cycle without needing to be managed closely, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time
  • Own the full recruiting function for a growing multi-state facility services operation
  • High-ownership role with direct impact on the company's ability to staff and grow

What You'll Work On

Sourcing and Pipeline Management

  • Post and maintain job listings continuously across all active markets and job platforms
  • Build and manage a candidate database that the company can draw from when new work comes in
  • Source candidates for janitorial, security, concierge, front desk, maintenance, and specialty cleaning roles
  • Attend hiring events and recruitment fairs as needed to expand the candidate pool

Screening and Qualification

  • Review resumes and conduct phone screenings in English and Spanish
  • Verify candidate credentials including specialty licenses such as the SORA license for New Jersey security roles
  • Assess candidates for reliability, schedule fit, and growth potential — for example, asking concierge candidates whether they would consider obtaining a SORA license
  • Match candidates to specific schedule profiles including roles suited for retirees, students, or other availability patterns

Interview Coordination and Onboarding

  • Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers across multiple locations
  • Complete pre-employment processes including background checks and employment verification
  • Support candidate onboarding and ensure a smooth handoff to operations
  • Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout every stage of the process

ATS and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the applicant tracking system
  • Track pipeline activity, open roles, and hiring progress across all active markets
  • Build relationships with hiring managers to understand current and upcoming staffing needs

What You Bring

  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken — this is a non-negotiable requirement
  • Minimum of 2 years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience, preferably in frontline, blue-collar, or high-volume environments
  • Experience recruiting for security, janitorial, concierge, maintenance, or similar service industry roles strongly preferred
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust with candidates and hiring managers
  • Experience using an applicant tracking system — ADP Workforce Now or similar preferred
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously
  • Comfortable verifying credentials, licenses, and employment documentation as part of the screening process
  • Self-directed and results-oriented with the ability to own a full recruiting cycle independently
  • Available Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for security roles requiring SORA or similar state-specific licensing
  • Familiarity with employment laws and hiring best practices across multiple US states
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting a company through rapid headcount growth
  • Background recruiting across multiple geographic markets simultaneously

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in both English and Spanish, describing your recruiting experience, and walking through how you manage a high-volume pipeline across multiple open roles simultaneously

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are bilingual, experienced in frontline recruiting, and want to own the talent acquisition function for a growing facility services company with real hiring volume across multiple states, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Manager of Developer Tooling, you will be tasked with leading the team responsible for designing, building, and operating our CI/CD pipelines. This team sits within the Developer Experience organization and is at the center of how every engineer ships code. You will set the technical direction for our pipeline platform and partner with Infrastructure Services and product engineering teams to deliver a fast, reliable, and self-service path to production.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers building and operating CI/CD pipelines and pipeline tooling.
  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and reliability of our CI/CD pipelines from source to production.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into the developer workflow including AI code review on pull requests, AI generated tests, intelligent test selection and flake detection, AI assisted failure triage, and engineering intelligence dashboards that surface bottlenecks and impact.
  • Partner with the broader DevEx organization to roll out, support, and measure adoption of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across product engineering teams.
  • Build paved road templates, reusable libraries, and golden paths that make doing the right thing the easiest thing for product teams.
  • Drive measurable improvements in pipeline reliability, build and test duration, and developer wait times.
  • Partner with security to build supply chain controls, policy enforcement, and AI specific guardrails into the pipeline.
  • Work closely with the Infrastructure Services team that owns CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms, and with product engineering teams that consume the pipelines.
  • Establish on call practices, incident response, SLOs, and continuous improvement loops for pipeline systems.
  • Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and create an environment where strong engineers do their best work.
  • CI/CD pipelines are the circulatory system of an engineering organization, and AI is rapidly becoming part of that bloodstream. The Manager of Developer Tooling will lead the team that defines how code reaches production, safely, quickly, confidently, and increasingly with AI as a first class participant in the workflow. This is a critically important role with significant impact on engineering velocity and reliability across the company.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 7 or more years of engineering experience with 2 or more years managing engineers, ideally in DevOps, platform engineering, or developer experience teams.
  • Strong hands-on background with CI/CD systems including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Tekton, or similar, including pipeline as code patterns.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into the development workflow including AI code review, AI test generation, AI coding assistants, or engineering intelligence platforms such as LinearB, DX, Jellyfish, Faros, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of ArgoCD or comparable GitOps tooling and artifact management systems like Artifactory, Nexus, or Harbor.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and cloud native deployment models.
  • Experience designing shared libraries, templates, or platforms used by many internal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to translate technical strategy for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A service mindset measured by the productivity and happiness of the engineers you serve.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're looking for a Product Design Lead to own UX/UI across our Ü Snacks brand portfolio, from launching new products to optimizing site performance and user flows. You'll build scalable design systems, improve conversion across our ecommerce ecosystem, and partner with cross-functional teammates to create best-in-class experiences. This role is perfect for someone who is equal parts strategic and hands-on, deeply curious about customer behavior, and obsessed with great design. If you want to shape how our brands show up online and actually see your work drive conversion, this is that role. You'll report directly to the VP of Ecommerce. This is a hands-on, maker-first role — you'll spend the majority of your time designing and shipping the work yourself, with a smaller people management component.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together twice a year for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead UX/UI across the full funnel (PDP, cart, checkout, account, first-order flow) with an eye on conversion, not just polish
  • Design experiences for new product and brand launches that match packaging quality from day one
  • Own and evolve our cross-brand design system (Figma components, tokens, patterns) so every brand ships fast without quality drift
  • Translate our brand books into a premium digital experience across typography, motion, imagery, and information hierarchy
  • Partner with the CRO team to keep the landing page test pipeline full with high-quality, on-brand variants
  • Manage and mentor a direct report, setting the craft bar and helping them grow into a stronger designer
  • Review and calibrate work across the design team and agency partners, raising the bar on everything that ships

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8+ years in product/UX/UI design, including 5+ years designing for premium DTC ecommerce on Shopify or Shopify Plus
  • Has built or rebuilt a design system from the ground up, including tokens, components, documentation, and governance, and can point to real adoption
  • Has a portfolio that shows unmistakably on-brand, premium work, not a templated Shopify build
  • Understands DTC funnel mechanics deeply (PDP, cart, checkout, subscription, upsell) and can explain design decisions in conversion terms
  • Has experience designing across multiple brands or product lines at once
  • Is a power user of Figma and uses AI to speed up their own design process

Approach to the role:

  • Operates as a player-coach: ships work personally and raises the bar for the team around them
  • Thinks in systems and components, not one-off pages
  • Balances craft and conversion on every decision, and can articulate the tradeoff
  • Brings a strong point of view without ego, and collaborates well across growth, brand, lifecycle, and engineering
  • Owns the outcome. Doesn't wait for a perfect brief. Pulls context and moves.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $140,000-$160,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Director, AI Engagements
jobs.excerpt: Harbor Labs is a new team within Harbor focused on solving hard AI implementation problems in the legal market.
jobs.description:
Harbor Labs is a new team within Harbor focused on solving hard AI implementation problems in the legal market. We have strong hypotheses about what works, but we're building this like a startup: learning as we go, adjusting direction based on what the market tells us, and staying flexible about how we operate.

We're looking for a Director of AI Engagements to lead our most important client relationships and set the strategy for how we deploy AI in production. This is a senior role for someone who can sit across the table from a GC or COO, shape the direction of an engagement, and then roll up their sleeves and build alongside the team to deliver it.

This is a leadership role, but not a hands-off one. You'll own the strategy for your engagements and stay close enough to the work to configure systems, pressure-test outputs, and make the calls that determine whether AI actually sticks in a client's day-to-day.

What Makes This Different:

Our edge is combining deep legal domain experience with product sensibility and strong engineering. We understand how legal teams actually work, what change management looks like in risk-averse environments, and how to build software that people will use. We also know the common pitfalls of enterprise software in traditionally low-innovation areas like law, and we're determined to avoid them.

We focus on hard, novel problems where standard platforms fall short. The work is ambiguous, the solutions aren't obvious, and that's the point. As a senior leader here, you set the bar for how we approach those problems and how we show up with clients.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the strategy for your engagements. Shape what success looks like with the client's leadership, define the roadmap, and make the prioritization calls. You're accountable for the outcome and the relationship, not just the deliverable.
  • Lead at the executive level. Be the trusted partner to GCs, COOs, and heads of legal operations. Translate where AI is heading into a concrete plan they can get behind, and bring skeptics along.
  • Stay hands-on with the work. Configure systems, structure knowledge sources, write and refine prompts, design test cases, and validate outputs against real data. You lead from inside the work, not above it.
  • Set direction for delivery. Define how an engagement is scoped, staffed, and sequenced. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and delivery leads to turn an ambiguous business problem into a production system.
  • Design the operating model, not just the workflow. Figure out how AI changes the way a legal team operates: the processes, the roles, the governance. Redesign how the work gets done, then make the change actually happen.
  • Drive architecture and integration decisions. Partner with engineers on how AI fits into client tech stacks: APIs, data flows, security and compliance requirements. Hold the line on what's production-grade.
  • Help build Harbor Labs itself. This is a ground-floor leadership opportunity. You'll shape how we sell, how we deliver, who we hire, and where we go next.

What We're Looking For:

  • You operate like an owner. You've run engagements, programs, or a function end-to-end and been accountable for the result. You set direction when there isn't one and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
  • You lead from the front, hands on the work. Seniority hasn't pulled you away from the details. You're as comfortable in a configuration screen or a prompt as you are in a boardroom, and you believe the two can't be separated.
  • You've delivered real change in how teams work. You understand legal operations, professional services, or a comparable environment, and you've redesigned how people actually do their jobs, not just shipped a tool.
  • You're deeply fluent in AI, but not captured by hype. You understand how these systems work in production: RAG architectures, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, evaluation methods. You know how to separate signal from noise when every vendor claims to be the next breakthrough.
  • You hold current model-provider credentials. Anthropic Academy certifications (AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations, Claude Code, Building with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol) are a strong plus, and current OpenAI Academy coursework counts too. We treat these as a real signal, not a checkbox: they show you're building with today's tools, not describing yesterday's.
  • You're technical-adjacent and unafraid of it. You don't need to write Python all day, but you can read an API doc, reason about a system architecture, and have a credible conversation with engineers about tradeoffs.
  • You command a room at any level. Executive presentations, working sessions with skeptical users, hard conversations about scope and risk. You build trust fast and hold it under pressure.
  • You're relentlessly practical. You care about what works in production and what changes client behavior, not what sounds impressive in a deck.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Harbor Labs is new and the market is evolving. You'll set the playbook, not follow one.

Nice to Have:

  • Senior experience in legal operations, legal technology, or a transformation/innovation function
  • Track record leading client engagements in consulting or professional services
  • Experience at a product company (product, solutions, or delivery leadership)
  • Hands-on experience with a broad range of AI development tools and LLM APIs

Why Harbor Labs:

We're a small, senior team working on hard problems with clients who are serious about deploying AI in production. The work is hands-on, the ownership is real, and the leadership you exercise here will directly shape what this team becomes.This is early. You'll have meaningful input into the strategy, the team, and what Harbor Labs grows into.

How to Apply:

Send us a note about why this role interests you and an engagement or initiative you led that you're proud of, ideally one where you set the strategy and stayed close to the work. Examples and references matter more to us than a polished resume.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, age, parental status, disabled status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Reporting to the Director of Professional Services, the Principal Engagement Manager is Clariti's most senior client-facing delivery leader: a recognized thought leader, trusted executive advisor, and force multiplier for the broader Professional Services organization. Operating at the Expert level across all competency pillars, you won't simply manage implementations - you'll define how they are delivered, shape the frameworks the organization scales with, and mentor the next generation of Clariti delivery talent. While this is not a management role, you will leverage your experience to influence and develop the team.

At this level, you see beyond the project to the system. You unlock new business opportunities, forecast trends before they surface, and balance customer, partner, and business priorities with the nuance that comes only from deep institutional knowledge and battle-tested judgment. You hold the attention of executive audiences, navigate the most complex stakeholder dynamics, and build the organizational structures and cultures through which great delivery consistently happens.

If you have a proven track record of leading high-visibility, high-risk programs across government and civic technology - and you're driven to shape how a high-growth SaaS company delivers transformation at scale - this role is built for you.

As a Principal Engagement Manager at Clariti, you’ll be accountable of:

Strategic Delivery Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of Clariti's most complex, highest-visibility engagements, managing project governance, schedules, budgets, milestones, and success criteria across concurrent implementations with multiple client organizations.
  • Articulate clear delivery vision and strategic priorities to align large, cross-functional teams, including Implementation Consultants, Delivery Architects, Technical Account Managers, and Product and Engineering, ensuring every team has clear authority and targets that ladder up to shared outcomes.
  • Support continuously improving Clariti's repeatable delivery frameworks, structured retrospectives, and customer feedback loops, pioneering innovative solutions where no standard playbook yet exists and driving sustainable process improvement across the PS organization.
  • Anticipate risks and crises before they materialize; proactively devise and execute contingency plans, managing project scope changes and emerging threats with high autonomy and minimal escalation.

Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the most senior client stakeholders, mayors, CIOs, department directors, and agency heads, building deep relationships before dependencies arise and breaking down barriers between client functions and Clariti teams.
  • Lead recurring executive steering committees and check-ins, connecting project progress to city outcomes in a way that holds the attention of, and inspires, senior audiences, adjusting presentations in real time based on audience reaction and handling challenging Q&As with confidence.
  • Anticipate stakeholders' agendas and potential objections; proactively prepare and deploy effective engagement strategies that gain alignment across competing motivations and diffuse tension before it escalates.
  • Understand and manage the full spectrum of stakeholder interests, across regions, functions, and organizational levels, determining the appropriate style and depth of engagement for every interaction.

Delivery Excellence & Quality

  • Champion a delivery culture grounded in structured, data-backed metrics and storytelling, connecting performance to tangible government outcomes such as reduced permitting times, faster intake cycles, and measurable throughput improvements that give stakeholders the evidence to trust and advocate for Clariti.
  • Design systems and organizational structures for delivery teams that translate into consistently high-quality output, including resource models, delegation frameworks, and performance review cadences that keep teams engaged and accountable.
  • Apply advanced process improvement principles to deploy sustainable delivery initiatives; build a data-driven culture of continuous improvement and defect reduction across PS engagements.
  • Implement rigorous quality control processes; ask targeted questions that surface potential challenges without getting lost in the weeds, and validate impact through structured, transparent performance reviews.
  • Plan and prioritize resources across multiple concurrent engagements to ensure sufficient resourcing for targeted timelines, balancing utilization, team health, and delivery quality without burnout.

Organizational Learning & Knowledge Leadership

  • Build city personas, engagement playbooks, and scalable frameworks that translate project-level insights into organizational learning, distributing knowledge across PS and feeding structured product feedback into Clariti's roadmap.
  • Surface customer insights that influence Clariti's product and go-to-market strategy, acting as the voice of the customer in cross-functional conversations with Product, Engineering, Sales, and executive leadership.
  • Teach and develop the next generation of Clariti delivery talent, mentoring Principal ICs, Lead ICs, and Engagement Managers through coaching, modeled behavior, and structured development opportunities.
  • Leverage network and external influence to recruit and hire strong delivery talent; use institutional knowledge to identify and champion high-potential team members.
  • Consistently seek out new sources of knowledge and best practices; develop and distribute written knowledge pieces, playbooks, guides, frameworks, that enrich Clariti's delivery capability at scale.

Reporting & Cross-Functional Contribution

  • Provide regular reports and updates to the PS Director of Implementation and COO on the performance, risks, and strategic progress of all assigned engagements, structured for executive consumption and actionable by leadership.
  • Engage senior leadership through planning cycles, progress reports, and presentations for highly visible, broad-scale programs requiring extensive cross-functional coordination.
  • Contribute to Clariti's strategic planning by identifying new business opportunities with measurable impact to company objectives, informed by deep understanding of customer and partner nuances.

What do you bring to the team? 🧠

Experience & Track Record

  • 12+ years of experience leading and delivering enterprise-level or government transformation engagements in a SaaS, professional services, or civic technology environment.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing the most complex, highest-risk, multi-stakeholder programs end-to-end, including situations requiring recovery from dissatisfied clients or failed prior implementations.
  • Acknowledged thought leader within at least one prior organization on delivery methodology, client engagement, or public sector implementation.
  • Experience designing and owning delivery frameworks and feedback loops at an organizational level, not just executing within them.

Expert-Level Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Sees and unlocks new business opportunities with measurable impact; leverages understanding of customer and partner nuances to balance competing priorities; forecasts trends and builds strategic relationships across functions.
  • Financial Acumen: Own and actively manage engagement-level financial performance, including project budget forecasting, cost tracking, margin analysis, and variance reporting across a portfolio of concurrent engagements. Apply expert-level financial acumen to model delivery scenarios, assess trade-offs between scope, cost, and timeline, and make or recommend resource allocation decisions that protect both client outcomes and Clariti's financial health.
  • Communication: Holds the attention of large executive audiences; adapts presentations in real time; handles challenging Q&As and ad hoc speaking requests without preparation; structures all communication types for any audience.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies problems before they surface; persuades cross-org stakeholders to undertake innovative process improvement; pioneers solutions where no standard exists; builds data-driven improvement cultures.
  • Customer Centricity: Intimately understands customer journey; builds and inspires a culture of high-quality service across the organization; drives NPS improvement through cross-functional collaboration and influence.
  • Executional Excellence: Designs organizational systems and structures for teams that translate into high-quality output; motivates and inspires through challenging periods; plans across multiple initiatives without burnout.
  • Functional Expertise: Recognized thought leader and go-to advisor for delivery and implementation; teaches next-generation experts; uses network to recruit and develop strong talent.
  • Planning & Organizing: Articulates clear strategic vision; manages high-visibility, high-risk, broad-scale programs; proactively manages scope changes, crises, and contingencies.
  • Problem Solving: Drives organizational alignment for solutions affecting Clariti's overall position; develops new frameworks for complex problems; operates efficiently at top-level stakeholder scale.
  • Stakeholder Management: Breaks down barriers across functions and organizations; invests in relationships before dependencies arise; effectively manages complex conflict and ensures productive cross-team relationships.
  • Teamwork: Cultivates collaborative environments across levels, functions, and geographies; champions and develops high-potential team members; balances team protection with broader company objectives.

Technical & Methodological

  • Deep expertise in project management and agile methodologies with demonstrable evidence of applying them to large-scale transformation.
  • Strong data literacy, ability to establish baselines, define the right success metrics, connect project health to measurable outcomes, and communicate data-backed stories to executive audiences.
  • Proficiency in leading organizational change and managing ambiguity; exceeds customer expectations in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Familiarity with public sector or civic technology projects strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel within the United States and Canada approximately 30-40%.

Bonus Points 🎉

  • Experience with Salesforce-based platforms or GovTech/civic technology ecosystems
  • Familiarity with permitting, licensing, or government service delivery workflows
  • Experience managing System Integrator (SI) partner relationships on joint delivery programs
  • Background in organizational change management (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated interest or hands-on experience applying AI tools to improve implementation workflows, documentation, or delivery efficiency
  • Experience in teams or practices transitioning toward AI-assisted delivery models

What’s in it for you?🫵

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $195-235K based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

Senior Global Project Manager – Immunology, Metabolic, and Oncology (Sponsor-Dedicated) - Home Based in US

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Senior Global Project Manager – Immunology, Metabolic, and Oncology

Sponsor-Dedicated - Fully Home Based anywhere in US

About the Role:

Within this sponsor, the Clinical Trial Leader (CTL) serves at the Senior Project Manager level and plays a pivotal leadership role within the Clinical Delivery Team. This position provides strategic global oversight, driving alignment, direction, and accountability across Phase II and III clinical trials conducted worldwide. The CTL ensures precise planning, efficient execution, and high-quality delivery of trials that bring speed and value to patients and investigative sites.

Operating across multi-country, multi-regional trials, the CTL provides strong global project management leadership, ensuring milestones, KPIs, and strategic objectives are met. Therapeutic areas include Immunology, Metabolic, and Oncology. Candidates must have extensive Project Management experience leading Phase II & III trials globally, with proven ability to influence and guide diverse teams.

What You Will Do:

Global Trial Preparation

  • Lead global planning activities and operational feasibility assessments, ensuring timelines and strategies are realistic and globally aligned.

  • Strengthen cross-functional cohesion by working onsite with colleagues in Statistics, Data Management, Medical Writing, Site Monitoring, Quality, and Regulatory.

  • Guide country allocation and feasibility processes, helping shape global site strategies with operational insight.

  • Develop robust global engagement, recruitment, and risk mitigation plans informed by patient, site, and regional feedback.

  • Lead vendor outsourcing strategy—identification, evaluation, and scope-of-work development—ensuring global operational readiness.

  • Bring teams together onsite to harmonize trial processes across clinical quality, safety, investigational product management, and financial planning.

  • Prepare or support responses to regulatory and ethics authorities across regions.

  • Ensure global teams are trained, aligned, and equipped for execution.

Global Trial Conduct

  • Maintain high-level oversight of worldwide trial operations, ensuring compliance with GCP, SOPs, and diverse regional regulations.

  • Monitor global patient recruitment, risks, timelines, and budgets, driving issue resolution through clear leadership.

  • Direct documentation changes, study amendments, and retraining across all regions and functions.

  • Provide strong oversight of global vendors, central labs, and external partners, ensuring consistent performance.

  • Serve as the connective tissue across global clinical delivery, fostering open communication and unity of purpose.

  • Coordinate biomarker, genomic, and sub-study activities for applicable early-phase trials, often requiring cross-regional alignment.

Trial Closeout & Reporting

  • Provide global leadership through data cleaning, database lock, and closeout activities.

  • Support CTR development and ensure timely global registry disclosure.

  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of the Trial Master File (TMF) across all participating regions.

  • Support scientific publications and global communication of study outcomes.

Strategic Contributions

  • Partner with portfolio leaders to provide operational and scientific insight that shapes global study strategy.

  • Elevate risks, bottlenecks, and insights to the Evidence Team to drive swift, coordinated solutions.

  • Lead or contribute to global feasibility assessments that influence trial design, operational models, and regional planning.

What You Will Bring:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree (4-year undergraduate degree).

  • Proven experience providing global leadership across Phase II & III clinical trials.

  • Therapeutic area experience in Immunology, Metabolic, or Oncology.

  • Deep understanding of global clinical trial planning, execution, and regulatory landscapes.

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across complex, matrixed, multicultural environments.

  • Ability to lead through influence, anticipate global challenges, and ensure patient-focused outcomes.

Core Competencies

  • Global Leadership: Confidently guide teams across regions, cultures, and functions; set vision, instill accountability, and shape high-performing global execution.

  • Strategic Mindset: Think several steps ahead, anticipate challenges, and align global strategies with portfolio needs.

  • Project Management Excellence: Expert in global timelines, risk mitigation, cross-functional coordination, issue escalation, and solution delivery.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Build trust across continents; unify teams through clear direction and inspiring presence onsite.

  • High-Impact Communication: Transparent, diplomatic, and culturally attuned communicator who elevates team performance.

Why Join This Team:

This is not a traditional project management role — it is a chance to be at the center of global clinical delivery. As a Senior Global Project Manager / Clinical Trial Leader, you will be a visible, influential leader driving the success of trials that span continents. The hybrid model gives you the best of both worlds: meaningful onsite collaboration that strengthens team cohesion, paired with the flexibility of remote work.

You will shape strategy, drive execution, and help deliver therapies that change lives. Your leadership will connect people, processes, and science — ensuring trials advance efficiently, ethically, and with global impact.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

$114,000.00 - $210,900.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.excerpt: About the ClientWe're helping a fast-growing Google Ads agency based in the Netherlands find a Social Media Strategist to lead the company's Instagram and TikTok strategy.
jobs.description:
About the Client

We're helping a fast-growing Google Ads agency based in the Netherlands find a Social Media Strategist to lead the company's Instagram and TikTok strategy.

The agency helps eCommerce brands scale through high-performance advertising and has already established a strong reputation through educational content and YouTube. Their next stage of growth is building Instagram and TikTok into consistent lead generation channels that attract qualified inbound enquiries.

This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and shape the strategy behind a rapidly growing personal brand and content engine.

The Role

We're looking for a Social Media Strategist with a proven track record of growing founders, coaches, consultants, agencies, brokers, or other service-based businesses through social media.

This is not a community management or content production role, nor is it suited to someone whose experience is primarily with large consumer brands.

Instead, we're looking for someone who understands how service businesses generate trust through content—using storytelling, education, lead magnets, and strategic content pillars to turn attention into qualified leads.

You'll own the Instagram and TikTok strategy while working closely with the founder, who records the videos, and a VA who handles editing and publishing.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: CET business hours (Netherlands)

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Monthly Rate: USD $1,600–1,920/month (depending on experience)

What You'll Do

Social Media Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end Instagram and TikTok strategy.
  • Build social media into a predictable lead generation channel rather than simply growing followers.
  • Develop long-term content strategies aligned with business growth objectives.
  • Research competitors, founders, coaches, agencies, and creators to identify winning content frameworks.
  • Recommend new content formats, lead magnets, campaigns, and growth experiments.

Content Strategy & Copywriting

  • Develop content pillars that position the founder as an authority.
  • Create compelling hooks, storytelling frameworks, captions, and carousel concepts.
  • Plan educational content that nurtures prospects through the buyer journey.
  • Develop lead magnet ideas and social campaigns that generate enquiries.
  • Ensure all messaging feels authentic, educational, and human.

Content Direction

  • Guide the founder on:
    • Topics to cover
    • Stories to tell
    • Hooks to test
    • Educational concepts to explain
    • Trends worth leveraging
  • Base recommendations on research, platform insights, and audience behaviour.

Content Quality & Operations

  • Review and approve content before publication.
  • Provide creative direction to the VA responsible for editing and scheduling.
  • Maintain consistently high content quality.
  • Ensure publishing remains consistent and aligned with the overall strategy.

Research & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously research:
    • Competitors
    • Coaches
    • Agencies
    • Founders
    • Personal brands
    • Content hooks
    • Storytelling frameworks
    • Platform trends
    • Audience behaviour
  • Translate insights into practical weekly action plans and content recommendations.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience developing social media strategies for service-based businesses (at least 3 years).
  • Demonstrated experience working with founders, coaches, consultants, agencies, brokers, or personal brands.
  • Strong Instagram and TikTok expertise.
  • Exceptional copywriting and storytelling skills.
  • Experience creating content that generates qualified business leads—not just engagement.
  • Strong understanding of lead magnets, content funnels, and educational marketing.
  • Experience planning content pillars and long-term content strategies.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Highly proactive, strategic, and commercially minded.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience within digital marketing or performance marketing agencies.
  • Familiarity with Google Ads or lead generation businesses.
  • Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Canva, Metricool, CapCut, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of broader content marketing and marketing funnels.

Portfolio Requirements

As part of your application, we'd love to see at least one detailed case study demonstrating your work with a founder-led or service-based business.

Examples may include work for:

  • Coaches
  • Consultants
  • Agencies
  • Mortgage brokers
  • Real estate professionals
  • Financial advisers
  • Personal brands
  • Other service-based businesses

Your portfolio should ideally include:

  • Visual examples of Instagram or TikTok content
  • Content pillars and overall strategy
  • Storytelling approach
  • Reels or carousel examples
  • Lead magnets or content offers
  • The thinking behind the strategy
  • Measurable business results (where available)

Experience working with major consumer brands is valuable, but for this role we're particularly interested in seeing how you've helped service businesses build authority, generate trust, and convert social content into qualified leads.

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Thinks strategically rather than tactically.
  • Understands how founder-led brands build trust online.
  • Loves researching competitors and identifying winning content strategies.
  • Can simplify complex ideas into engaging educational content.
  • Takes ownership and proactively drives new ideas.
  • Understands that social media success is measured by qualified enquiries—not vanity metrics.
  • Thrives in entrepreneurial, fast-moving environments.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of a high-impact strategic function within a growing digital marketing agency.
  • Work directly with an experienced founder who values initiative and strategic thinking.
  • Shape the content strategy behind a growing personal brand.
  • Play a key role in transforming Instagram and TikTok into scalable lead generation channels.
  • Enjoy long-term growth opportunities as the company's content marketing function expands.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview & Portfolio Review
  2. Client Interview
  3. Practical Assessment (if deemed necessary by the client)
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What You Will Do:

  • Manage a team by hiring and onboarding talent, setting clear expectations, conducting formal performance reviews, and coaching accountability.

  • Drive implementation of the Medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) with strong enforcement of layer responsibilities, ensuring repeatable and auditable pipeline behaviorleveragingBoomi,Dbt, Azure Data Bricks, Boomi/Rivery, Delta tables, andSqlServer.
  • Partner closely with the Data Architect to bring the architecture to life through concrete implementation patterns, reference pipelines, and guardrails—ensuring the team can consistently execute the intended approach.
  • Reduce friction by driving crisp decisions and forward motion—using lightweight decision records, seeking the right input, and then executing accountability (while avoiding overly heavy process).

What You Bring to the Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or relevant professional experience.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience in software / data engineering, including building production data pipelines and data platforms.
  • 2+ years of experience in lead capacity (formal or informal) including team leadership, task breakdown, reviews, delivery ownership, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience directly managing a team, including hiring/interviewingand conducting formal performance reviews.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark), Boomi/Rivery, and Delta Lake patterns for scalablelakehouseprocessing.
  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT design and implementation, including orchestration/ingestion into transformation workflows across curated layers.
  • Experience partnering with application and database teams to define efficient, non-disruptive data access patterns for upstream SQL Server systems (read replicas, CDC, snapshot isolation, batching strategies).
  • Demonstratedexpertiseimplementing Medallion architecture with clear separation of concerns across Bronze/Silver/Gold, including enforcing “no consumer reads from Bronze” style guardrails.
  • Strong understanding of ingestion/source variability (APIs, CDC-enabled databases, file drops) and the ability to selectappropriate ingestionstrategies per source contract.
  • Track recordof improving team maturity from reactive delivery to repeatable engineering execution (standards, patterns, documentation, and predictable throughput). Interest and ability in mentoring and/or training other team members as applicable.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and promoting collaborative partnerships to drive results.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively to various audiences/levels, both internal and external stakeholders, including leadership through various mediums.
  • Ability to present and convey material both formally and informally to all levels of an organization.
  • Proven organization skills with the ability to address short-term and long-term demands simultaneously.
  • Easily adaptable with the ability to pivot with changing business needs, keeping a professional demeanor and leading by example for other colleagues.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage workload and meet project deadlines.
  • High levelof confidence, integrity, and professional courtesy.
  • Strong Microsoft suite experience, including teams or similar web conferencing and internal communication software experience preferred.
  • Naturally inquisitive with a desire to learn, solve problems, and dig into detailed analysis.
  • Experience working in a fully remote team is preferred but notrequired.

Salary Range

The base salary for this position is $140,000 - $185,000 annually. Consistent with applicable laws, compensation will be determined based on the candidate's level, relevant skills, qualifications, and experience along with requirements for the position and annual financial plans.

Skillable is a distributed first team with employees working across the U.S., and we do not consider geography when determining compensation ranges.

Skillable wants to be a company that promotes physical, emotional and all around well-being through our benefit offerings! jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the role:

AssemblyAI runs a mature, multi-framework security and compliance program—including SOC 2 (all trust criteria), ISO 27001, and PCI 4.0—that protects the infrastructure and customer data behind our industry-leading Voice AI API. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in the security space to join our IT & Security team as the company's first security engineering role.

This role sits at the intersection of security engineering and security operations. You'll split your time between hands-on engineering work—threat modeling, secure code reviews, security tooling, and infrastructure hardening alongside our platform and product engineering teams—and the operational work that keeps our security program running: compliance audit cycles, vulnerability management, customer questionnaires, and monitoring. You should be energized by both sides of that equation, not just one.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team. You'll work closely with engineers across the company, partner with sales and legal on customer-facing security needs, and have a direct hand in shaping how AssemblyAI secures its products, infrastructure, and internal tools—including a rapidly growing landscape of agentic AI development.

What You’ll Do:

Security Engineering

  • Conduct threat modeling and security design reviews for new features, services, and architectural changes—partnering with product and platform engineers early in the design phase.
  • Perform secure code reviews and provide actionable feedback, focusing on authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets management, and data protection.
  • Deploy and maintain security tooling across the development lifecycle—SAST, SCA, DAST, secret scanning, IaC scanning, and CI/CD security guardrails.
  • Support best practices to adopt secure-by-default libraries, frameworks, paved-road patterns, and developer guidance to reduce classes of vulnerabilities across the codebase.
  • Partner with platform engineering on infrastructure and environment security—including AWS resource hardening, Terraform-managed infrastructure reviews, network segmentation, and environment isolation improvements.
  • Contribute to incident response for security events: investigation, root cause analysis, and post-incident hardening.

Security Operations

  • Drive vulnerability triage and prioritization across teams, tracking remediation against targets and reporting metrics. Step in to remediate directly through patches and PRs where you identify high-impact opportunities.
  • Partner with sales and legal responding to customer and vendor questionnaires, RFP security sections, and trust-and-safety inquiries.
  • Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI 4.0, and other compliance audit cycles by gathering evidence, documenting controls, and coordinating with auditors.
  • Monitor and respond to alerts from endpoint, cloud, and application security tools; manage vulnerability tracking and remediation follow-up across the environment.
  • Execute recurring user access reviews, IAM hygiene tasks, and RBAC maintenance required by compliance frameworks.
  • Maintain and improve security runbooks, process documentation, and operational playbooks—building automation where possible to reduce manual burden using AI-assisted development tools.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, security operations, or a related role that combined both
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI compliance audit cycles—you've gathered evidence, documented controls, and worked with auditors, not just read about it
  • Strong application security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure code review, and familiarity with common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE)
  • Experience with security tooling across the development lifecycle: SAST, SCA, DAST, secret scanning, or IaC scanning
  • Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and services, including IAM, VPC networking, and security configurations
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD pipeline security
  • Proficiency in Python and comfort reading code across backend services
  • Strong written communication skills—you'll write audit documentation, security questionnaire responses, policy documents, and runbooks regularly
  • Comfort using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) to write scripts, build automations, and accelerate documentation—AI tool fluency is a core expectation at AssemblyAI

Nice to have

  • Experience securing AI/ML systems or inference infrastructure
  • Familiarity with endpoint security platforms and cloud security tooling
  • Security incident handling experience: building SIEM detections, writing queries, managing alerting and triage pipelines
  • Experience with vulnerability management programs: building triage workflows, managing SLAs, and reporting metrics
  • Security certifications (CISSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent)
  • Experience at a high-growth startup in a security role

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range: $180,000 - $220,000 USD

The expected base compensation for this role is listed above. Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer-paid benefits, and the flexibility of being fully remote. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

Job Title: Principal Medical Writier

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced PrincipalMedical Writer to lead the development of high-quality clinical and regulatory documents supporting global regulatory submissions. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that documents such as Investigator’s Brochures (IBs), Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), and Module II summaries that are scientifically accurate, consistent, and aligned with program objectives and global regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will act as a lead writer for key summary documents, providing strategic guidance to cross-functional teams while overseeing medical writing activities across multiple compounds. This position reports to the Director of Medical Writing (or above).

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of high-quality clinical and regulatory documents (e.g., Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, clinical summaries, and marketing authorization submissions) in compliance with global regulatory guidelines (ICH, FDA, EMA) and internal standards

  • Serve as the lead writer for key summary documents, overseeing medical writing activities across multiple compounds or programs

  • Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on document content, messaging, and regulatory positioning to ensure alignment with program goals

  • Manage medical writing projects, including planning, timelines, resource coordination, and delivery to ensure milestones and submission deadlines are met

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Safety, etc.) to gather, interpret, and accurately present clinical data

  • Mentor and support other medical writers, ensuring high-quality, scientifically sound, and consistent deliverables across projects

  • Review and edit project-related documents to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and compliance with templates and style guides

  • Attend project and team meetings to provide expert input on document development, study data interpretation, and process improvements

  • Contribute to and lead process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency in document preparation

  • Develop, maintain, and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates, and best practices for medical writing

  • Stay current with evolving global regulatory requirements, industry trends, and therapeutic area knowledge to ensure compliance and innovation

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, clinical, regulatory, or related field required; advanced degree (e.g., MSc, PhD, PharmD, MD) preferred

  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience in medical writing within the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry; equivalent experience in clinical or preclinical development will also be considered

  • Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA) across all phases of clinical development

  • Broad understanding of clinical research processes, including study design, data analysis, and regulatory submission requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to lead writing activities for complex documents and provide strategic input to cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly and accurately present complex scientific and clinical information

  • Strong organizational, time management, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, team-oriented environment while also operating independently when needed

  • High attention to detail with a commitment to quality, consistency, and scientific accuracy

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and document formatting best practices

We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.
