About PK Software

PK Software builds pharmacy management software for compounding pharmacies across the United States and Canada. As part of PCCA (Professional Compounding Centers of America), we combine deep compounding expertise with modern technology to help independent pharmacies run their businesses with confidence. We are investing heavily in the customer experience, including a next-generation cloud platform, and education is at the center of that strategy.

About the Role

We are hiring an Onboarding & Education Manager to build and own customer education at PK Software. This is a builder role. You will stand up our learning management system (LMS), produce video-based training content, design structured learning paths for pharmacy staff, and help customers get real value from our software faster.

The role is roughly 80% customer education and 20% customer onboarding. Most of your time goes to building scalable education: courses, videos, learning paths, and self-serve content. When onboarding demand peaks, you will step in alongside our Onboarding team to implement and train new customers directly. That hands-on time keeps your content grounded in how pharmacies actually use the product.

What You Will Do

Customer Education (approximately 80%)

  • Build and own the customer education strategy and roadmap, maturing us from ad hoc training to a structured, scalable education program
  • Implement and administer our LMS, including course structure, learning paths, enrollment, and reporting
  • Plan, script, record, and edit product training videos and eLearning modules
  • Design role-based curricula for pharmacy owners, pharmacists, and technicians, covering both new customer training and ongoing education for existing customers
  • Build assessments and, over time, certification paths that validate customer proficiency
  • Assist the Support team with knowledge base articles and help documentation, keeping written content consistent with course material
  • Host live training sessions, webinars, and office hours as needed
  • Partner with Product to keep content current with each release, and build training for major launches, including our next-generation platform
  • Track education metrics such as course completion, engagement, support ticket deflection, and time-to-value, and use the data to improve the program

Customer Onboarding (approximately 20%)

  • Serve as flex capacity for the Onboarding team during peak periods, guiding new customers from kickoff through go-live
  • Deliver live implementation training, remote and occasionally on-site
  • Feed what you learn from onboarding directly back into course content and documentation
  • Help standardize onboarding materials so every customer gets a consistent experience

What We Are Looking For

  • 3 to 5+ years in customer education, training, onboarding, instructional design, or enablement at a software company
  • Hands-on experience administering an LMS and building courses within it
  • Demonstrated video production skills: scripting, screen recording, and editing with tools such as Camtasia, Descript, Loom, or similar
  • Strong instructional design fundamentals and an understanding of adult learning principles
  • Confident presenter, comfortable on camera and leading live training for groups
  • Clear, plain-spoken writer who can turn complex workflows into simple guides
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to run multiple content projects at once
  • Data-minded, with the habit of measuring whether training actually works

Nice to Have

  • Pharmacy, compounding, or healthcare software experience
  • Experience building an education program or academy from the ground up
  • Familiarity with customer education platforms such as Thought Industries, Skilljar, LearnUpon, or Absorb
  • Experience with in-app guidance tools or certification programs
  • Customer onboarding or implementation experience in B2B SaaS

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Our LMS is live with a complete new-customer curriculum and role-based learning paths
  • A library of current, high-quality training videos covers our core product workflows
  • New customers complete structured training as part of onboarding, improving time to go-live
  • Education metrics are tracked and reported, with clear evidence of ticket deflection
  • You have personally onboarded customers and used that experience to sharpen the program

Why PK Software

  • Build a function from the ground up with real ownership and executive support
  • Serve independent pharmacy owners who genuinely rely on your work
  • Join a team investing in its product, its customers, and its people
  • Competitive salary and benefits through PCCA

jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible, helping founders spend less time thinking about financial infrastructure and more time building their businesses. You can explore our product at .

Behind every product we ship is a network of banking and payment partners that make those experiences possible. Those partnerships require more than great products. They require thoughtful operational systems, trusted relationships, and seamless execution across dozens of teams.

That's where Product Partner Operations comes in.

Product Partner Operations owns the strategy and execution behind the operational frameworks that enable Mercury's banking and product partnerships to scale. We build the systems, documentation, communication patterns, and partner relationships that create trust, reduce operational friction, and allow Mercury to launch ambitious products with confidence.

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partner Operations to lead a team of Partner Operations Specialists supporting Mercury's Banking and Expansion product organizations.

This is a people leadership role first - you’ll help your team excel in their impact and sharpen their execution through thoughtful coaching, clear expectations, and operational rigor. You'll build the frameworks that allow the team to scale alongside Mercury, ensuring our operational systems become more resilient, our documentation more durable, and our cross-functional partnerships even stronger as we continue to grow.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, and our external banking partners to improve how work moves across organizations. Whether you're introducing a new partner implementation, improving how partnership context is documented, or helping teams navigate organizational change, your work will make it easier for Mercury to build products that feel effortless for customers while maintaining the trust of our partners.

Secure, reliable, thoughtful, and perhaps even magical is how customers should describe banking on Mercury. Your team's work is one of the reasons they can. You'll build the operating frameworks, documentation, and partnerships that make extraordinary customer experiences feel effortless while ensuring Mercury continues to scale safely and confidently.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Operations Specialists through thoughtful feedback, clear expectations, and intentional career development.
  • Build durable operational frameworks that improve how Mercury manages existing and future product partnerships across Banking and Expansion.
  • Raise the bar for operational quality by improving documentation, knowledge management, and communication systems that reduce institutional dependencies and create lasting organizational context.
  • Lead organizational change initiatives, helping the team adopt new processes, tooling, and operating models while maintaining execution quality through periods of rapid growth.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, and external banking partners to solve complex operational challenges and improve how work moves across organizations.
  • Establish and evolve performance metrics that measure operational health, partner experience, and team effectiveness.
  • Drive strategic planning, prioritization, and resource allocation to ensure the team is focused on the highest-impact work.
  • Champion scalable tooling and workflows, including Linear and other operational systems, ensuring Mercury's partnership context remains accurate, discoverable, and actionable.
  • Advocate for your team, creating alignment across stakeholders while protecting focus and helping others understand the strategic value of Product Partner Operations.
  • Help shape the long-term strategy for Mercury's product partnership ecosystem as we continue expanding our banking capabilities.

You should:

  • Have 7+ years of experience leading operational programs at a fintech, financial institution, or similarly complex, highly regulated environment.
  • Have 3+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Have demonstrated success partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, and cross-functional business leaders and Executives to drive strategic initiatives.
  • Be relentlessly curious, seeking to deeply understand how organizations work before introducing change.
  • Have experience leading operational change management and building alignment across many stakeholders with competing priorities.
  • Be an exceptional written and verbal communicator who believes documentation is a strategic advantage, not an administrative task.
  • Have a track record of designing operational systems that reduce complexity, eliminate bottlenecks, and continue to scale long after they're introduced.
  • Be comfortable balancing long-term strategic initiatives with time-sensitive operational priorities.
  • Stay calm under pressure while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Be motivated to leverage tools, automation, and thoughtful process design to help the team scale its impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners alike.
  • Be deeply obsessed with quality, always asking how today's solution can continue serving Mercury years from now.

Compensation:

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

As we continue to expand our operations in the UK, we're looking for an Area Sales Manager to help scale our established Independent Sales Consultant (ISC) channel across North East London.

This is a fast-paced, high-velocity field role working alongside self-employed sales professionals who operate as independent partners. Reporting into a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) and supported by the wider channel team, you'll build a high-performing, sustainable regional operation taking responsibility for coaching and developing your ISCs from their very first week through to the point they're ready to operate independently.

This is a hands-on, field-based role with real autonomy. Success is measured by both the revenue impact you drive and the strength and maturity of the channel you help build.

Day-to-day you’ll be responsible for:

  • Build, lead and inspire a commission-only sales network, setting the standard, driving accountability, and earning influence without relying on traditional management levers.

  • Take full ownership of your team's commercial performance, turning a self-employed consultant in their first week into a high-output revenue engine.

  • Be there for every step of the ISC journey with a particular focus on their first 90 days, showing up in person, building trust, laying the foundations of the partnership and making every stage of the Teya journey count.

  • Get out in the field alongside your ISCs, coaching live on merchant calls, running weekly reviews, and doing whatever it takes to keep your team sharp and on track.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by running regular quality assessments with Sales Enablement and RSMs, identifying blockers, pricing issues and at-risk ISCs before they become problems.

  • Unite new joiners and experienced sellers across your territory through monthly in-person sessions that forge a genuine team culture and fuel consistent performance.

  • Dig into the data to uncover growth opportunities, cut through friction, and keep your region accelerating.

  • Champion the consultant experience at every level, taking field insight directly to Product, Marketing and Operations to make Teya's tools, messaging and resources the best they can be.

Your Story

  • Proven track record in B2B field sales, ideally within payments, fintech or software.

  • Commercially literate and comfortable with performance data, incentive structures and the unit economics that drive a healthy channel.

  • Highly organised and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities and keep standards high in a fast-moving environment.

  • A direct, empathetic communicator who can give honest feedback and hold people accountable without losing the relationship.

  • Process disciplined and familiar with structured framework and what it takes to build something that scales.

  • Car owner/driver with willingness to spend a minimum of 50% of your time in the field across your region.

The Perks

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team.

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme.

  • Health and Life Insurance.

  • Enhanced Pension Scheme.

  • 25 days of Annual Leave.

We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Occupational Health bet inside New Ventures based in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Occupational health is one of the largest, most regulated, and most stubbornly analog corners of corporate wellbeing. In Brazil alone, it is a multi-billion real market: every company is legally required to run occupational exams, manage regulatory compliance (NR-01 and the new psychosocial-risk mandate, eSocial reporting), and look after the health of its workforce. Yet the industry still runs on paper, manual scheduling, fragmented clinics, and reports nobody reads. We intend to rebuild it, at AI speed.

You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Occupational Health bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build: the thesis is set, the market is chosen, but the product, the workflow, and the operating model are still being invented. You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own product for the Occupational Health bet: translate the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and market insight into product requirements, sequencing, and a roadmap that gets us to paying customers fast, and keep reshaping it as we learn.
  • Redefine the workflow, don't digitize the paperwork: question every legacy step, the manual exam booking, the paper ASO, the compliance theater, and rebuild it around the member, the company, and AI. A faster PDF is not the answer.
  • Make AI the core mechanic, not a feature: work with engineering to embed AI into scheduling, triage, compliance reporting, and the back office, so a lean squad can do what an incumbent's much larger operation does today.
  • Build for regulated ground truth: work hand in hand with legal, compliance, and SST domain experts to make sure the product is correct on NR-01, eSocial, and psychosocial-risk requirements before it is fast or delightful. In this market, compliance failures are not a bug, they are existential.
  • Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, and report progress in a way that is honest about what's working and what isn't.
  • Work close to the customer: get in front of HR and SST buyers, clinics, and brokers yourself, alongside the commercial team, so product decisions are grounded in what you've heard directly, not what's been relayed to you.
  • Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.
  • Bring judgment in ambiguity: make calls with incomplete information, defend the ones that matter, and change your mind fast when the evidence says to.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Genuinely AI-native: you reach for AI as the default way to do more with less, direct agents to compress manual work, and are comfortable being a beginner on things AI changes every month.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills: able to use data and metrics to generate insight, prioritize ruthlessly, and know what to measure when the business itself is still being defined.
  • Entrepreneurial and self-driven, with a bias to ship and sell as the way to learn, balanced with the judgment to know which corners cannot be cut.
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook: this bet doesn't have an established product organization or years of process behind it; you'll help build both as you go.
  • Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

About Engine

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we’re here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That’s why we’re building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the FinTech vertical. The Accounting integrations team is responsible for the last touchpoint in the Engine user journey. Every line of credit, every booking, every direct bill needs to land cleanly in our customers' ERP systems. Right now that gap costs us deals. You'll close it. From day one, help design the integrations layer, and own it as the team scales. QuickBooks is already live. Netsuite is in progress. Sage, Xero, Oracle Fusion, and eventually expense platforms like Expensify and Concur are next.

This is a team where 95% of code is AI-generated, PR reviews are being phased out, and the FinTech group leads the entire company in AI development. If you want high ownership, real external-facing technical work, and a team that takes AI seriously — this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build integrations between Engine's billing system and major ERP platforms — QuickBooks, Netsuite, Sage, Xero, Oracle Fusion
  • Work directly with external vendors: navigate their APIs, attend architectural onboarding sessions, and get your integration designs approved
  • Own the full integration lifecycle — from vendor demos through to production and ongoing support
  • Lay the architecture for future expense management integrations (Expensify, Concur, and others)
  • Collaborate with the billing team and internal accounting stakeholders to ensure the line-of-credit-to-ERP flow is accurate and reliable
  • Use AI tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as your primary development environment — this team generates ~95% of code with AI

What You'll Do

  • Drive the design and implementation of a greenfield services, replacing legacy code with modern microservices, strong test coverage, and production-grade observability
  • Enable other product teams by building and maintaining integrations they depend on
  • Collaborate closely with other teams to translate accounting requirements into engineering solutions
  • Use AI tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as your primary development environment

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Strong system design skills — you can walk through architectural decisions you've made, explain tradeoffs, and think at the infrastructure level
  • Excellent communication — you can explain technical problems clearly to non-technical stakeholders like accountants and business ops teams
  • AI fluency — you're comfortable using Claude, Cursor, or similar tools as your main coding interface; you don't just use them occasionally
  • Proven delivery — you've shipped complex systems, not just features; you can speak to the weight and scope of what you've built
  • Java or Kotlin experience (preferred by the team)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in FinTech, payments, fraud, or billing systems — adjacent domains like fraud prevention or payment logistics count
  • Experience building ERP or accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Netsuite, Sage, Xero, Oracle Fusion, or similar)
  • Terraform, Datadog, or Splunk experience

This is a contractor role for candidates based in Latin America. Applications for this role will be accepted through September 30th until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We’re looking for Senior Integrations Engineers to join our growing team! This role is instrumental in supporting our expansion in our hyper growth phase. You’ll play a key role in designing, building, and scaling our integrations powering our product. You’ll work alongside our engineers, implementation specialists, support, and product managers to build real-time and batch data integrations with our partners and clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Build robust healthcare integrations without compromising security, privacy, or quality. These integrations will leverage technology standards using REST-like APIs, healthcare standards such as FHIR, and other third-party APIs.

  • Scale up our business by designing, building, and supporting our integrations and infrastructure

  • Collaborate closely with our health system customers to deploy, troubleshoot, and support integrations. Be comfortable engaging with external partners and stakeholders.

  • Enhance existing systems to add new functionality, and to improve performance, stability, quality, and security

  • Advocate for high standards; make quality-of-life improvements to the codebase; add documentation and share knowledge; and help limit the growth of technical debt

  • Build deep user empathy and maintain a user-centric mindset

  • Communicate regularly and effectively within and on behalf of our cross-functional product delivery teams. You’ll work with other disciplines, including design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure, and will have opportunities to learn from and contribute to projects across the company

    What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience launching business-critical integrations with large enterprises

  • 2+ years of VistA Integration experience

  • Experience with mPage Workflow components, Dynamic Documentation, and CCL

  • Experience working with technologies REST-like APIs (FHIR), OAuth2.0, mTLS

  • Excitement about working on our tech stack, which include NodeJS/TypeScript and Google Cloud Platform

  • Passionate about working in healthcare integrations

  • Ability to act with autonomy & self-direction while working well in a team environment

  • Willingness to pitch in wherever needed - as a fast-moving startup we need to do good work, quickly

  • Comfortable with working across domains and languages with a curiosity to experiment & learn new things

  • Strong communication with internal and external stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years of experience working with healthcare data integrations

  • Experienced in delivering integrations with EHRs like Oracle Health/VistA and others

  • Familiarity with one or more of the following technologies: FHIR, HL7, X12

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

jobs.excerpt: A Funcional Health Tech é movida pela certeza de que a Saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.
jobs.description:
A Funcional Health Tech é movida pela certeza de que a Saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para prover o ecossistema da saúde com soluções que geram eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia.

Aqui, você irá participar, de maneira direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para os mais diversos serviços de saúde porque essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, porque está em nosso DNA.

Sua missão como Pessoa Analista Infra Pleno, será:

  • Assegurar a disponibilidade, segurança, estabilidade e eficiência dos ambientes cloud, híbridos e on-premises, atuando na sustentação, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de TI.
  • Administrar, monitorar e otimizar ambientes em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS e Azure, garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance, escalabilidade e melhor custo-benefício.
  • Gerenciar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes (K8S), incluindo deployments, namespaces, policies, ingress, autoscaling, troubleshooting e administração de workloads containerizados.
  • Administrar servidores Linux e Windows Server, realizando configurações, atualizações, hardening, troubleshooting e gestão de acessos.
  • Operar, administrar e suportar ambientes VMware (vSphere, vCenter e ESXi), incluindo provisionamento, manutenção e otimização de máquinas virtuais.
  • Implementar, manter e automatizar infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Atuar na automação de rotinas operacionais e pipelines CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub e GitLab.
  • Implementar e monitorar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog, Prometheus e Grafana, garantindo visibilidade de infraestrutura, aplicações, eventos e custos.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração e modernização de ambientes, incluindo migrações on-premises para cloud e entre provedores cloud.
  • Atuar em estratégias de backup, disaster recovery (DR), continuidade de negócios e alta disponibilidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de recursos, performance e redução de custos em ambientes cloud.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, governança e compliance regulatório.
  • Administrar redes cloud e conectividade híbrida, incluindo VPCs, VPNs, balanceadores de carga, DNS e integração entre ambientes.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes críticos, problemas de infraestrutura e troubleshooting avançado.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento, segurança, arquitetura e operações na evolução contínua dos ambientes.

jobs.title: Chief External Affairs Officer
jobs.excerpt: Overview Common Future works to close the racial wealth gap.
jobs.description:
Overview
Common Future works to close the racial wealth gap. Our current economic system does not work
for everyone. Generations of Black and Indigenous communities and other communities of color
have been and are currently intentionally locked out of wealth and power, holding us all back.
Founded in 2001, Common Future is building a future where all people—no matter their race and
class—have power, choice, and ownership over the economy.
As a women-led, multiracial organization, our diverse team of strategists, community organizers,
financial activists, and policy enthusiasts provides capital, operational support, and strategic
partnership to budding solutions addressing racial and economic injustice. To advance racial and
economic equity, Common Future incubates, co-creates, and funds field-defining initiatives and
influences key sectors. We collaborate with leaders who have the imagination and courage to
rethink our economy. We bring initiatives that model how to build wealth and power in excluded
communities to life.
Our culture values include centering equity, being the communities we serve, embracing
experimentation, reimagining what’s broken, collectively solving problems, and modeling a new
way of working. We strive to be an innovator that prioritizes the well-being of our employees.
Read more about us at commonfuture.co.
Purpose

Common Future is seeking a Chief External Affairs Officer to serve as a senior executive leader responsible for building and sustaining the financial foundation and brand reputation that makes our mission possible. This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment: as the landscape for equity-focused organizations grows increasingly complex and the need for durable, flexible funding becomes more urgent, Common Future needs a bold, relationship-driven leader who can match the ambition of our programmatic work with an equally ambitious funding and communications strategy. The Chief External Affairs Officer will own Common Future's revenue strategy across institutional philanthropy, individual donors, capital raising, and emerging revenue streams, developing a business model that supports both organizational sustainability and economic independence.

Success in the role includes owning a $10M total annual fundraising goal, which includes $6 - 7M in operations and $3M in investment capital. The CEAO will hold a personal portfolio of funder and investor relationships, including high-net-worth and big-bet philanthropic prospects, and will be an active and visible presence in the field, traveling to conferences and convenings (20-25% time) to build new relationships and deepen existing ones.

In addition, the Chief External Affairs Officer will steward Common Future's brand and strategic communications, including providing guidance to the team managing public relations and cross-platform media. This senior leader will remain attentive to the external environment and develop strategies to support the positioning of the Co-CEOs, our organizational impact, and our collective thought leadership.

As a member of Common Future's Executive Leadership Team, the Chief External Affairs Officer will partner closely with the programmatic team leads on revenue strategy, ensuring that fundraising is tightly integrated with programmatic priorities, and will work in a matrixed fashion across the Impact Investments, Initiatives, and Finance teams. They will oversee Fund Development and Strategic Communications, and will set the tone for a culture of excellence, creativity, and deep relationship-building in service of an equitable economy.

Position Responsibilities

    Revenue Strategy and Business Model (30%)

  • Develop, own, and implement a comprehensive revenue strategy across institutional philanthropy, individual donors, high-net-worth giving, capital raising, and online/digital fundraising channels.
  • In close partnership with the Co-CEOs, own a $10M total annual fundraising goal which includes $6 - 7M in operations and $3M in investment capital.
  • Assess existing strategy and infrastructure quickly, identify what is working, and build forward without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Lead and steward Common Future's business model with a cross-organizational lens, identifying opportunities to diversify and strengthen revenue streams, increase unrestricted and flexible funding, and build long-term financial sustainability and economic independence.
  • Partner with programmatic team leads and the CFOO to align fundraising strategy with programmatic priorities, ensuring that restricted and unrestricted funding opportunities are pursued in ways that serve organizational strategy and budgetary allocations.
  • Collaborate across teams to align and integrate revenue strategies organization-wide, including: a) capital raising with Impact Investments and our affiliate organization, Community Credit Lab (CCL); b) restricted grant fundraising with our programs team; c) Finance; and d) digital fundraising.
  • Track, analyze, and report fundraising performance to the Co-CEOs, Executive Leadership Team, and Board.

    • Funder and Investor Relationship Management (20%)

  • Generate, hold, and actively steward a personal portfolio of institutional funders, high-net-worth individuals, and capital investors, with a particular focus on big-bet and transformational giving opportunities.
  • Travel to conferences, convenings, and in-person engagements at least 2 - 3 times per quarter to build and deepen funder and investor relationships and represent Common Future externally.
  • Develop and lead cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies for current and prospective funders across all giving levels, applying an equity lens to how capital is pursued, including prioritizing funders aligned with Common Future's values, challenging extractive funding dynamics, and modeling the kind of capital relationships the organization advocates for in the broader ecosystem.
  • Identify and pursue new philanthropic, corporate, and capital sources aligned with Common Future's mission, including donor-advised funds, national donor circles, and emerging giving vehicles.
  • Support and participate in funder diligence and pre-diligence processes for the CCL Fund and other capital-raising efforts in coordination with the Impact Investments team.

    • Brand, Positioning, and External Relations (20%)

  • Steward and strengthen Common Future's brand, ensuring it is compelling, consistent, and resonant across platforms and external audiences including funders, partners, media, and the broader field.
  • Ensure that Common Future's narrative and brand strategy is tightly integrated with fundraising efforts, creating a coherent and compelling story for diverse audiences.
  • Work collaboratively with communications and programmatic staff to produce high-quality external-facing materials including proposals, impact reports, one-pagers, and case stories, ensuring ongoing, timely, and strategic placement.
  • Ensure high-quality execution of communications across all organizational channels, checking for internal alignment with the strategic plan and theory of change

    • Team Management and Leadership (20%)

  • Directly manage the Fund Development and Strategic Communication teams, with accountability for team performance, professional development, and budget.
  • Rapidly assess team capacity, individual development needs, and systems gaps to build a path forward.
  • Hold a strong vision for the Fund Development team's work as it builds toward achieving organizational revenue goals, and effectively cultivate a culture of excellence, creativity, and accountability.
  • Provide strategic guidance, coaching, and support to direct reports, including on grant writing, funder engagement, pipeline and portfolio management, and systems and operations.
  • Identify and create opportunities to develop the professional expertise of Fund Development team members.
  • Oversee fiscal management of the Fund Development team budget in coordination with the Finance team.
    • Executive Leadership and Cross-Organizational Collaboration (10%)

ABOUT POWER FACTORS

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

ABOUT THE ROLE

Power Factors is seeking a talented Senior Sales Engineer to join our growing Global Sales Engineering team. Sales Engineering is an entrepreneurial, cross-functional discipline at Power Factors that requires multiple skill sets and involves significant interaction and coordination with our prospective customers and internal teams. We work in tight collaboration alongside Account Management, Sales, Business Development, and the Product teams to deliver consistent and comprehensive proposals and messaging to our customers. The role serves as the primary technical contact for the customer throughout the sales process. As such, the Senior Sales Engineer is responsible for collecting customer requirements, developing both technical and commercial proposals and conveying the overall solution to the customer catering to their depth of understanding. Post-sale the role interfaces with engineering and customer success among others to ensure a seamless handoff and fulfillment of project commitments.

Power Factors works with the world’s most prominent renewable energy companies, and the Sales Engineering team is responsible for setting top-notch, professional first impressions. Clear, efficient verbal and written communication, asking the right questions, active listening, and learning are paramount in your efforts to build relationships and trust, both individually and between organizations. You will have the mandate to ensure a smooth customer experience from top-of-funnel sales engagements through contract signing, and you will build the templatized tools and processes that will enable the company to continue to effectively scale. The role reports to the Sales Engineering Manager.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Coordinate technical components of commercial discussions and engage with clients and colleagues to collect and interpret project documentation.
  • Collaborate with the wider sales team and subject-matter-experts to develop and present proposals for our products and services in response to client RFP/RFQ’s.
  • Manage scope alignment, identify gaps, and roadmap commitments between Sales and Product.
  • Maintain product databases by routinely engaging with product vendors to ensure the team is using up to date pricing and is aware of product availability.
  • Conceptualize and design the overall system architecture of the proposed solution in terms of plant network, plant control and data acquisition functions and integration with other systems, delivery substation protection as well as remote platforms. Close cooperation with Delivery, IT and Product teams is assumed.
  • Enter customers and project information into CRM, manage templates and document repositories.
  • Deliver sales presentations with a keen awareness and deep understanding of the audience’s desired outcomes and pain points and how the Power Factors’ offering addresses them.
  • Represent Power Factors at industry events and trade shows.
  • Schedule and host project hand-off meetings with internal teams responsible for scope execution, including Engineering and Customer Success teams.
  • Quickly jump into complex problems and navigate competing priorities to drive solutions, using a combination of interpersonal and technical skillsets.
  • Contribute to company process improvement and documentation.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

We believe you enjoy working in a purpose-driven organization and that you thrive in an environment where you need to find creative solutions to challenging problems in a fast-changing context. This also means that you are effective at managing multiple tasks of varying complexities, work well under pressure, and are driven by continuous learning and growth. Specifically, we are looking for someone with the following toolbox:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, etc.
  • Five or more years of relevant experience with technical product/project management, estimation, and IT/networking in the renewable and storage industry (including utilities, EPCs, third-party O&M organizations, etc.)
  • Experience with Operational Technology (SCADA, automation systems, etc.) and the ability to interpret networking, data flows and electrical diagrams.
  • Familiarity with drawing tools (CAD, Sketchup, Visio, or others) and experience drafting diagrams to facilitate sales conversations.
  • Proven track record of successful performance in fast-paced environments coupled with the skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Fluent in English with clear and concise written and oral communication.
  • Ability to think technically and manage both details and the big picture.
  • Skilled in connecting with all relevant audiences within an organization with the right message and detail.
  • Experience performing autonomously as an individual contributor and as a project coordinator.
  • Capacity to create solutions and solve problems through logical and innovative techniques; take responsibility; drive resolution; execute.
  • Process-oriented with a demonstrated history of managing resource conflicts.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Using and configuring DAS/SCADA systems
  • Familiar with electric industry standard communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, IEC60870-5-104/101, IEC61850 etc.)
  • Technical writing, marketing, and RFP responses
  • Salesforce or equivalent CRM or ERP

LIFE @ POWER FACTORS

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

WHY JOIN US

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

Wij helpen je graag goed op weg. Daarom zorgen wij ervoor dat de leads die je binnenkrijgt, van hoge kwaliteit zijn. Je helpt klanten om hen zo goed mogelijk inzicht te krijgen in de mogelijkheden. Met de hulp van onze slimme software. Die berekent alles in no-time en denkt meerdere scenario’s voor je uit. Zo kun jij je focussen op de klant.

Flexibiliteit is belangrijk. Je bent vrij om zelf je agenda in te delen en je uren te bepalen. Wil je naast je werk ook eigen klanten adviseren? Ga ervoor. Zelf kiezen waar je werkt? Jij bepaalt. En ga je op vakantie? Dan is er een team Fritsers die je klanten tijdelijk kunnen overnemen.

Waarom je bij ons past

Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

  • Je werkt al minimaal vijf jaar als adviseur.

  • Je hebt ervaring met klanten uit verschillende situaties. Denk aan starters, verhuizers, oversluiters of ondernemers.

Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit

Bij Frits is iedereen welkom. We vinden het superbelangrijk dat de werkomgeving van iedere Fritser veilig voelt en inclusief is. Onafhankelijk van wie je bent of waar je vandaan komt. Diversiteit maakt ons juist sterker, beter en zorgt ervoor dat we een open en heldere blik hebben. Om dit te behouden hebben we een sollicitatieprocedure opgezet waar iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt om aangenomen te worden. Welkom bij de Frits Family.

Extra informatie

Beloningsmodel

Bij Frits werken we met een beloningsmodel dat net even anders is. Zo krijg je bij ons geen uurtarief of stukloon maar word je betaald per fase: zo hebben we een oriëntatie-, advies- en bemiddelingsfase. Aan het einde van de maand berekent Frits hoeveel afgeronde fases je kunt factureren. Daarna hoef jij alleen nog de factuur te sturen: lekker makkelijk.

Het is natuurlijk ook fijn om concreet te weten wat je gaat verdienen. Per finaal akkoord verdien je gemiddeld EUR 640. De meeste zzp’ers die fulltime voor ons werken, sluiten gemiddeld 14-16 hypotheken per maand af. Afhankelijk van hoeveel je werkt, heb je zo een idee van wat je kunt verdienen.

Beschikbaarheid

Je bent vrij om je eigen uren in te delen en te bepalen waar je werkt. Op ons kantoor of liever thuis: wat jij het fijnst vindt. Het is wel belangrijk dat je minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We believe technology should strengthen communities and support the professionals who lead their programs. Our team is committed to building meaningful tools while fostering a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

We take the work seriously. We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A senior C#/.NET engineer who modernizes the platform, not just maintains it

Our flagship product, Volunteer Impact, is a mature, revenue-generating platform built on VB.NET and .NET Framework. It works. It serves thousands of organizations. And it needs to move to .NET 10 and C# so we can hire, ship, and build on a modern stack.

You’ve done this before. You’ve been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-modern-.NET migration of a real production monolith where downtime had to be tightly managed. You know how to migrate incrementally without breaking a live system, and your opinions come from experience, not theory. You’ve lived in NHibernate, swapped out legacy DI containers and dead dependencies, and dealt with custom security frameworks that predate ASP.NET Core’s policy model.

You’re still hands-on. You write code daily, configure your own CI pipelines, and can replace a legacy dependency, validate the regression risk, and ship the change to production. You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

You do serious work with a small core team, supported by fractional DevOps and release expertise when it matters, and a dedicated quality engineering function that owns the regression gate protecting this migration. You own the technical path, make sound trade-offs, and work directly with those partners to move the platform forward. You’re here to build the engineering foundation, not inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the migration of the Volunteer Impact backend from VB.NET/.NET Framework to C#/.NET 10, defining the migration approach and executing it incrementally against a live production system
  • Modernize a custom security framework (70+ custom attributes) into something that works on the new stack, with zero authorization bypasses
  • Strengthen the existing CI/CD pipeline and, with our quality engineering function, wire in the gates that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach production
  • Ship migrated areas to production independently and incrementally while the legacy application keeps running
  • Become the second engineer who can independently cut, validate, and deploy a production release
  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of professional C#/.NET experience, with real depth in the framework, not just the latest version
  • You’ve personally led or been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-.NET Core (or later) migration of a large, production monolith serving paying customers
  • You’ve migrated a production system incrementally with minimal downtime and can articulate the approach you’d take here
  • Deep NHibernate experience is strongly preferred. We’re keeping NHibernate to reduce migration risk, so the value is understanding a mature data access layer, preserving existing behaviour, and knowing where modernization helps without unnecessary churn.
  • You’ve replaced legacy dependencies in production: DI containers, bundling frameworks, service hosting, and unsupported third-party libraries. You know how to swap critical components while the plane is flying.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy .NET ecosystem components: ASP.NET MVC-to-Core routing, custom security frameworks, and the kinds of dependencies that don’t have a clean upgrade path
  • Familiarity with migrating SSRS reports to a modern reporting platform is a benefit. We have a significant reporting footprint, so preserving report behaviour during that move would be valuable.
  • You’ve improved CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and know how to work with a quality function to build gates that catch functional and performance regressions early
  • You’re comfortable in a small core team with shared DevOps and DBA support available, and a dedicated quality engineering partner who owns the regression gate across our platforms. You can make sound technical decisions, debug hands-on, and know when to pull the right support in.
  • VB.NET familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement. The job is the conversion, not maintaining VB.NET.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿401(k) (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • ﻿﻿Paid parental leave
  • ﻿﻿Competitive comp package

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, programmable data centre infrastructure using software-defined networking principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

What You'll Do

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original OS kernel is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source Linux, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

  • Strong engineering and Computer Science fundamentals.
  • Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills.
  • 5+ Fluency in one of C or C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
